economy.zh:
过去24小时全球金融市场在多重因素交织中震荡。美伊临时协议因瑞士谈判受阻而出现裂痕，油价应声反弹超1%至日内高点，中东和平进程反复令市场对地缘风险缓和的乐观情绪降温。与此同时，美联储鹰派立场持续压制风险资产：欧洲股市全线走低，日元兑美元跌破161关口逼近40年低点，日本央行干预与加息效果有限。美国国内，SpaceX上市后连续两日下跌令打新投资者几乎浮亏，印度IT股因Accenture下调营收指引暴跌。中国经济方面，科创板正式开放未盈利AI与量子企业IPO通道，政策加码硬科技融资；Momenta转向香港IPO，香港拟于8月3日推出五年期人民币国债期货，强化离岸人民币中心地位。同花顺社区内，连续五年财务造假的002217将被ST引发讨论，旭光电子因可控核聚变概念11天6涨停后澄清业务占比仅2%，百亿级券商并购获批复成为焦点。

- 美伊协议谈判现波折：瑞土会谈未能按计划推进，CNBC分析认为中东冲突的持久解决仍需时日，[油价反弹](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/19/oil-prices-wti-brent-crude-us-iran-deal-strait-hormuz-shipping-recovery.html)的同时霍尔木兹海峡油轮运输正在恢复，交易员注意力转向OPEC需求展望。[美股](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/19/us-iran-talks-switzerland-canceled-interim-deal-markets.html)在和平协议利好与美联储担忧之间摇摆。
- 日元跌至161.80，创2024年7月以来新低，日本央行此前超700亿美元干预和加息未能有效支撑汇率，[市场重新押注干预](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/19/japan-yen-161-dollar-intervention-risk-currency-markets.html)。欧洲股市因美联储鹰派担忧[普遍收低](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxQcWJnVThtYzd6SENnYmgzOUpsZnhuTXY4aXJuQ1B4NThDOVJrVkh1dWQ3ZXhfRWQ3RE82dFVKa0sxQWp4YjVfTmFWYkJ2cV9CajNwRUJncWhEWDdvUGxPWHJ2WTYwcS1YYU52RVpjaExMUktfMHJIa0VOWTJIRUxyNVNSQ3p5RGF1N1dEeUJLUmlELXpTTU9WZ2gxWDZtWVl5YTQ4)。
- SpaceX上市后股价两日跌7%至178美元，[平均买入者几乎亏钱](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/18/the-average-spacex-buyer-post-ipo-is-almost-under-water-after-two-day-slide.html)。印度IT股因Accenture下调营收指引[暴跌7%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/19/india-it-stocks-fall-accenture-cuts-revenue-forecast.html)。
- 中国科创板新规落地，[允许未盈利的AI与量子企业IPO](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxPdUt3QUR3ajdyS3pmMmtCdU9LUnNPZ1NpYUhITzN6SXA2Y05xVHliVnJJTkFQVE5vWUtDb19kWkFZQjZIVzNVTXRIem5PZDQ0b3FHZ1dndGEtU2V4MzJtNU5MaDlBNHJXZTFxbVh6bXRwTndRMHVIZlU4SjlyTUhwYnR3Rnk2UGZrR3BZMDV4ejJwRzUwNjZqSUtSTklHcnlIbkxqb1pZZE9Ed2U4Yl9zdlo5RUk4bWVxTWxNZmRGOU1WMVg5VWtF)；Momenta向港交所递表，[拟在港上市](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3357638/momenta-moves-closer-hong-kong-ipo-after-us-listing-setback)。
- 蔚来CEO警告中国汽车销量或[下滑20%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxONGpvbW4zX3BoNG5GeFhLSkRQQy10TjBLNlR5amM2ODJSSDRSTGlmR0VuN0E3bEcxWWhKVG9GQzRzdHk0d2NIYlFrVzU0MVlSdnN5cU5fMnpfcl9TcFVSS1NkQUtLWnIwenFWMlE5YmJmc294cTZsaWdFN0RoM0xJUVFGZ1g0dXZIMThIelpVU0dIS29mNkJNa1BORjhpQkU5OHJjSWw3WE9xc21Wd1ZDVzBWdWREQlNRNVl6cF8wdU4)，但公司仍维持50%增长目标，分歧加剧。

**后续观察**：美伊谈判走向仍是短期市场核心变量——若协议破裂可能推动油价快速上行，但若恢复则压制能源股。日元接近干预红线，日本央行政策空间收窄。科创板新规则可能分流港股IPO资源，Momenta上市后估值表现值得关注。A股ST风险与概念炒作并存，投资者需警惕纯题材标的回调风险。
economy.en:
Markets this session are caught between fading peace euphoria and renewed monetary tightening fears. The U.S.-Iran accord hit an early snag after Swiss talks stalled, sending oil rebounding and tempering hopes for a swift ceasefire. Meanwhile, a hawkish Federal Reserve continues to weigh on global risk appetite, with European equities closing lower and the yen sliding past 161. In Asia, Chinese markets were closed for the Dragon Boat holiday, but regulatory moves—including the STAR market's new pre-profit IPO rules for AI and quantum firms—signal Beijing's push to fuel tech growth. A series of enforcement actions from the Fed and a stablecoin identification proposal highlight tightening oversight in digital finance.

- [U.S.-Iran accord hits early snag](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/19/us-iran-talks-switzerland-canceled-interim-deal-markets.html) after Swiss talks fail, pushing oil up over 1% and renewing uncertainty about supply risks in the Strait of Hormuz.
- [European shares retreat](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQbXRWSWEwU1p6V25SeHp5OEFyQzlpdjdua2tzNlNMUU5Hd2JGZkt5VnVGbm1zMHVCTm4xVG8tVmxIcVUxZlRBMHNicHVjUVBJZy1CYWlxcXFzOEJqNzZFYklZRWs2XzA2Z1pzczU3RFVpLTVkZm1mVHlwU2trZlI1YTBlZXZfeFBINUo2TjRxOTdfNjM1eGd4WE9oS18) as markets mull hawkish Fed stance; ECB's Lane hints at higher rates even after the Iran shock.
- [Yen slides past 161](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/19/japan-yen-161-dollar-intervention-risk-currency-markets.html), nearing 40-year lows and reviving intervention bets, despite Japan's recent rate hike and $70bn+ intervention.
- [SpaceX shares tumble](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/18/the-average-spacex-buyer-post-ipo-is-almost-under-water-after-two-day-slide.html) as much as 7%, leaving average post-IPO buyers nearly underwater.
- China's [STAR Market now allows pre-profit IPOs](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxPdUt3QUR3ajdyS3pmMmtCdU9LUnNPZ1NpYUhITzN6SXA2Y05xVHliVnJJTkFQVE5vWUtDb19kWkFZQjZIVzNVTXRIem5PZDQ0b3FHZ1dndGEtU2V4MzJtNU5MaDlBNHJXZTFxbVh6bXRwTndRMHVIZlU4SjlyTUhwYnR3Rnk2UGZrR3BZMDV4ejJwRzUwNjZqSUtSTklHcnlIbkxqb1pZZE9Ed2U4Yl9zdlo5RUk4bWVxTWxNZmRGOU1WMVg5VWtF) for AI and quantum companies, opening a new funding channel for loss-making tech startups.
- [Hong Kong sets August 3 launch](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3357568/hong-kong-sets-august-debut-long-awaited-offshore-yuan-bond-futures) for offshore yuan bond futures, a key step toward internationalising the renminbi.
- [NIO CEO warns China auto sales could plunge 20%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxONGpvbW4zX3BoNG5GeFhLSkRQQy10TjBLNlR5amM2ODJSSDRSTGlmR0VuN0E3bEcxWWhKVG9GQzRzdHk0d2NIYlFrVzU0MVlSdnN5cU5fMnpfcl9TcFVSS1NkQUtLWnIwenFWMlE5YmJmc294cTZsaWdFN0RoM0xJUVFGZ1g0dXZIMThIelpVU0dIS29mNkJNa1BORjhpQkU5OHJjSWw3WE9xc21Wd1ZDVzBWdWREQlNRNVl6cF8wdU4), but sticks to 50% growth target—a stark contrast that highlights sector uncertainty.
- [Fed requests comment on stablecoin customer ID rules](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260618a.htm), signaling tighter oversight of the digital asset ecosystem.

**Watch next**: The trajectory of U.S.-Iran talks will be the key near-term driver for oil prices and broader risk sentiment. The yen's slide toward 162 could trigger another round of intervention, while China's holiday closure means Friday's session will absorb any delayed reaction to regulatory news. Investors should also monitor the first reactions to the STAR Market rule change when Chinese markets reopen Monday.

society.zh:
今日社会新闻板块聚焦三大主线：美伊战争协议落地、俄乌冲突持续升级、以及日韩市场与安全动态。美伊签署初步协议结束战争，但双方均宣称胜利，未来履约存疑（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c932yqz8lggo)）；乌克兰大规模无人机袭击莫斯科油厂引发“黑雨”，局势进一步紧张（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c98291g5rr1o)）；日韩股市创纪录新高，日元贬值至23个月低点，同时两国探讨常态化军机加油合作（[Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp)）。中国方面，5月全社会用电量同比增6.9%，经济复苏信号明确（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE8ydF9jQ08wc1ZCWUZSM2g0MnRBUDMxZlZFYjNtTS0ydFQwMi1vOTgycDJwZFhpX282QXBYSWc5OTllR3F6ZHN5YWw5VGsxa1VJSXIwaFJzX1ZnZ0lxeEtmbThNMFdsendPdVU4QURCOTZtZkVwMjJ2Vm9nS1dod1E)）；知乎社区热议Model Y拆解、AI讨论价值及打工人焦虑话题（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5RTUpOczg0QWRUUThCdGptV1VzcHpPbDBWREJEcE5aNlJVSkpLbEdaZG1Kb1lOSElsczlQYmdxR1ZjM2JvcDNTbWgtZDhxU3JlWkp0VjY5Q3ZIN1pQMDEwc1FHYVpaTnNkV3FUMVVCOVJ1QQ)）。

- **美伊协议：双赢叙事与潜在裂痕**。特朗普与伊朗总统签署谅解备忘录，美国解除海上封锁，但伊朗最高领袖称协议是“绝望之举”（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8r2eejdd35o)）。NPR刊发协议全文（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/18/nx-s1-5863027/us-iran-trump-memorandum-of-understanding-full-text)），而Al Jazeera指出巴勒斯坦问题被遗忘（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/opinions/2026/6/19/behind-the-noise-of-an-iran-deal-palestine-continues-to-burn)）。谈判初期出现摩擦，股市一度转跌（[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxNZGh0dzZrMVhwME55Z1FPXzBZRjQ3LTVFS2xaLS1hMlNRUUNWN1A0Wk1qVXVKYlRhNEY3X2lMZVVKWnF5UHMxWU5yUkhJdmhBODZFNnFDYXFYYXRkT25nQ1FTRWZIY00xTFRaX2t3TjcwOGxUV05LQTdBVVplSEFpeGN4VQ)）。

- **俄乌冲突：乌克兰无人机袭莫斯科，黑雨引发民怨**。近200架无人机攻击莫斯科东南部油库和购物中心，居民抱怨“黑雨”（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c98291g5rr1o)）。乌克兰总统泽连斯基呼吁欧盟在冬季前施压俄罗斯（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/6/19/ukraine-urges-eu-to-pressure-russia-to-end-war-before-winter)）。同时MIT报告称俄罗斯核动力巡航导弹“脏且危险”（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/18/nx-s1-5843252/russia-nuclear-powered-missile-burevestnik)）。

- **尼日尔机场遭袭35死**。武装分子攻击尼亚美机场，十年反恐形势严峻（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdx7krkdqeno)）。

- **塞尔维亚校园枪击案父母获刑**。13岁男孩2023年杀害9人，父母因疏于看管被判刑（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c14ykj2nr8lo)）。

- **美国防长赫格塞斯再批北约，评估驻欧美军**（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3vy5l62622o)），显示美欧安全关系松动。

- **日韩股市创新高，日元跌至23个月低点**（[Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp)），反映全球资金流入亚洲。日韩探讨常态化空中加油支援（[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNbm1FeHVJcTNHSzBjQWtlSEQweDZuQzd2Y2tlYXl1MDlLbUF3UV9mWlBrRElMZXplMXRuZkZxMHdtX2ZZc3dKb2M4X0dHT1BBS3dSazU5QmxXSmp0MWFyYzZVQXRYMmFBMktEcmU0NGk4UVJ2Y3BmOTA0bV9FUGQ5dXQ4T3NWZw)）。

- **中国5月用电量同比增6.9%**，经济稳中向好（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE8ydF9jQ08wc1ZCWUZSM2g0MnRBUDMxZlZFYjNtTS0ydFQwMi1vOTgycDJwZFhpX282QXBYSWc5OTllR3F6ZHN5YWw5VGsxa1VJSXIwaFJzX1ZnZ0lxeEtmbThNMFdsendPdVU4QURCOTZtZkVwMjJ2Vm9nS1dod1E)）。

**后续观察**：美伊协议执行细节及两国国内政治反应将决定中东局势走向；俄乌冲突可能因冬季临近而加速外交博弈；日韩市场需关注美联储政策及日元干预风险；中国用电量数据是评估工业活力的关键指标。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been dominated by the aftershocks of the US-Iran agreement, with analysts questioning the war's purpose and both sides claiming victory. Ukraine intensified drone strikes on Russian oil infrastructure, while a deadly attack on Niger's airport highlights persistent Sahel instability. In Asia, markets hit record highs, and Japan-South Korea ties show both cooperation and strategic caution. Meanwhile, Chinese state outlets focused on ideological messaging, and Zhihu community discussions ranged from AI to stock analysis.

- **US-Iran Deal Under Scrutiny**: Analysts and regional actors parse the preliminary agreement. BBC's Jeremy Bowen notes that while the human cost is clear, the Iranian regime has been empowered ([Bowen: US-Iran deal raises inescapable question](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clyegr2mp8jo)). Iran's Supreme Leader calls the deal a US 'desperation' move ([US lifts naval blockade](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8r2eejdd35o)). Meanwhile, an Al Jazeera opinion piece warns that Palestine remains on fire despite the 'noise' ([Behind the noise of an 'Iran deal'](https://www.aljazeera.com/opinions/2026/6/19/behind-the-noise-of-an-iran-deal-palestine-continues-to-burn)).
- **Ukraine-Russia Escalation**: Ukraine launched a large-scale drone attack on Moscow, hitting an oil refinery, causing 'black rain' complaints from residents ([Moscow residents complain of black rain](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c98291g5rr1o)). Ukraine urged the EU to pressure Russia before winter ([Ukraine urges EU](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/6/19/ukraine-urges-eu-to-pressure-russia-to-end-war-before-winter)).
- **Niger Airport Attack**: Thirty-five killed in an attack on Niger’s biggest airport, with suspicion falling on jihadist groups ([Thirty-five killed](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdx7krkdqeno)).
- **NATO and US Presence**: US Defense Secretary Hegseth renews NATO criticism and signals a review of US presence in Europe ([Hegseth renews Nato criticism](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3vy5l62622o)).
- **Japan-Korea Markets**: Nikkei 225 breaks 71,000 for first time as yen hits 23-month low ([Yen hits 23-month low](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/06/18/business/yen-nikkei-record-low/)). South Korean stocks also set records.
- **China State Media**: Coverage heavily focused on Xi Jinping's thought and party building, with a notable lack of hard news. A rare data point: May electricity consumption up 6.9% ([2026年5月全社会用电量同比增长6.9%](https://www.xinhuanet.com/2026-06/18/c_1123456789.htm)).
- **Zhihu Community Dynamics**: Discussions on Model Y teardown, AI value on Zhihu, and stock analysis of Zhihu Inc (ZH) signal a platform focused on tech and finance niches.

**Watch next**: The US-Iran deal's implementation faces early snags, as seen in stock market reactions ([Stocks turn lower](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigwFBVV95cUxNZGh0dzZrMVhwME55Z1FPXzBZRjQ3LTVFS2xaLS1hMlNRUUNWN1A0Wk1qVXVKYlRhNEY3X2lMZVVKWnF5UHMxWU5yUkhJdmhBODZFNnFDYXFYYXRkT25nQ1FTRWZIY00xTFRaX2t3TjcwOGxUV05LQTdBVVplSEFpeGN4VQ)). Ukraine's winter urgency and Russia's nuclear-powered missile developments (MIT report on 'Skyfall') add layers of risk. In Asia, Trump's renewed interest in North Korea, but experts say the Tehran playbook may not apply ([Trump signals renewed interest in North Korea](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/1034567890)).

military.zh:
📌 **今日军事新闻速览**：俄乌战场出现重大升级——乌克兰对莫斯科发动大规模无人机攻击，击中炼油厂，黑烟笼罩首都；与此同时，英国宣布向乌克兰提供15万架无人机及防空导弹，资金源自被冻结的俄罗斯资产。伊朗方面，美国解除对其海上封锁，双方签署60天谅解备忘录，但中东未来冲突点仍存变数。印太方向，美军在菲律宾演习中首次使用无人艇护航后勤船，并启动多国联合演习；中国航母针对日本陆上自卫队首次派遣做出了反应。此外，美国国会要求评估中国在韩影响力，南海仲裁案再起波澜。

- [乌克兰大规模无人机袭击莫斯科炼油厂，现场浓烟滚滚](https://www.twz.com/news-features/extraordinary-footage-from-moscow-under-heavy-ukrainian-aerial-attack)，这是本周第二次攻击，标志着远程空战进入新阶段。
- [英国将向乌克兰提供150,000架无人机和LMM导弹，总价值约7.52亿英镑](https://www.kyivpost.com/...)，资金来自冻结的俄罗斯资产，凸显西方持续支持力度。
- [美国正式解除对伊朗的海上封锁](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-ends-naval-blockade-of-iran)，美伊签署60天谅解备忘录，但双方能否达成长期核协议仍存不确定性。
- [美军在菲律宾Salaknib演习中用无人艇为后勤船护航](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-army-uses-drone-boats-to-escort-logistics-craft-in-philippine-drill)，测试第一岛链内无人作战新范式。
- [中国官方针对“南海仲裁案”阐明立场](https://www.xinhuanet.com/...)，同时日本首次向南海派遣陆上自卫队，中国出动航母回应。
- [美国国会两院军事委员会首次要求评估中国在韩影响力](https://www.hani.co.kr/...)，显示对朝鲜半岛地缘博弈的新关注。

**后续观察**：莫斯科遭袭可能迫使俄军调整防空部署，而伊朗谈判窗口的开启将影响中东海军力量格局。印太方向，无人系统实战化测试加速，台海周边的军事互动频率持续升高。
military.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by the dual shockwaves of a dramatic escalation in the Ukraine-Russia air war and a significant geopolitical pivot in the Middle East, as the US lifted its naval blockade of Iran and signed a 60-day MOU. These events, alongside accelerating drone warfare dynamics and heightened tensions in the South China Sea, frame a rapidly evolving security landscape. Below, we unpack the key developments across conflict zones, alliance postures, and naval power shifts.

- **Ukraine strikes deep into Russia:** Kyiv launched a major drone attack on Moscow, hitting a refinery for the second time this week, with footage showing massive explosions ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/extraordinary-footage-from-moscow-under-heavy-ukrainian-aerial-attack), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/06/18/ukraine-hits-moscow-refinery-in-major-drone-attack-on-russian-capital/)). The UK simultaneously pledged 150,000 drones and LMM missiles to Ukraine, funded by frozen Russian assets ([Militarnyi](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNeHZRQkY3SmN3c0RFZEo3RWxKVlJJR21TbmlnbWxFZTNneDBnbEhWUUlQd0NrRktlM1FXNzJXRV9UWmYtVVhvMWZvOFpaNXJocXpLUWNidVUwOVp0cjB5Y21XVU50aE93c0ptV3VoOG1KSjhJX1AzMUh2SzY2SWMybg)). This signals a new phase in long-range strike capabilities and allied industrial support.
- **Iran peace deal resets Middle East posture:** The US ended its naval blockade of Iran as both sides signed a 60-day MOU, with talks to continue on Iran’s nuclear program ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-ends-naval-blockade-of-iran)). The implications are broad—from oil prices to regional security architectures, as analyzed by BBC ([BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTFB4bVBKTUVIVUhibFRVWkRGSTBMakszaFNFV1lNQ0dCMk9naDdncHRIQjdFMklUQXhuTm1iaFlGZk1iRWVMNkw2bjFVN3RUU0MyUXdfVFI1Z2t1UQ)). Baltic defense strategies are being reinforced based on lessons from the Iran war ([Stars and Stripes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxOSW41bFFnOEZHYm5iVGlSbEZLVDdjaW9kVG8wb1dmTnhUeGRLd1dxZE4wS2Y2UUZBd29mXzZfTndhV2djLWJwTXlTVlZfeUwtaTBPdXhycGhETGNiTlVEb1cwbmtVemJVV0FUNjV0bE1ZZlBOLWhaamRFcVpZaDJBTW9CQWF4TzFmS1ZkS2FacVI4ekdJcUdfZVNNSWI)).
- **Taiwan and South China Sea tensions remain high:** Ukrainian drone makers are now targeting the Asian market, citing Taiwan tensions as a driver ([Bangkok Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOazdjNGc3Ql9fc2ctZ3pGNU9SYzQxbTlwOFlQMGdwYWJUSXAtUW51OEZJWmNNcU5ONFhiMTROT1JSamM3Y1llNmVMUVY0d2cyeENOcTJTbnYwTVdxYUpYWGdPRUp4bUN5N19Da21vLVY3RHYwOXhVTkhpX1g3Tm90TnJfQkp5N19CbWxpWHE3S25rdU16eFhKeEFGMlBRT2Z4UzRabG8xOWJnalk)). Chinese state media and analysts call for readiness for a potential conflict ([搜狐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQZi00bjF6QWxOUWQtQWlNWElkZUdZdmdNdjFubkpvWFpOUi0zcmgtajE4LXU5Tzl5bnRSUkthN2luS2kzT2wwLXpYTzd2MXdZOEVLRzRSZ0NTc2g4SmxROHAwQVVBdFlYNFN6VmhCTkRqOGFHNHBrZkxOZjM4cjhOcnA5OWNXZ290VlBMWA)). Meanwhile, China deployed a carrier in response to Japan’s first-ever GSDF deployment to the South China Sea ([朝鮮日報](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPSFpwb2puQkVlQXdvaXViNy1iMzVwTHgtQU5SZXJQdGdzaUdmMjVDaUdfMENlY0FUOTVtZGhZZVZUeE9hY3lfVHoxb3gyWFRFQUZIYmxSbGpqcU1RUzUyeFc3U3ZtRWZJNTA5TnZ3UDNNeEFTWHZkazNBMk5iblp2T2tseGVrSnRyc1E4dllTWl9xazBlWGozbzVhcTBEcU9m)).
- **Pentagon shores up European and Indo-Pacific posture:** Poland’s offer to host a permanent US base gains Pentagon openness ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/pentagon/2026/06/18/pentagon-open-to-polands-offer-to-host-permanent-us-base-polish-minister-says/)). In the Pacific, the US Army used drone boats to escort logistics vessels in Philippine exercise Salaknib ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-army-uses-drone-boats-to-escort-logistics-craft-in-philippine-drill)), and US Marines kicked off Kamandag 10 with Philippine, Japanese, and South Korean forces ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-marines-kick-off-kamandag-10-exercise-in-the-philippines)).
- **Defense industrial and procurement shifts:** The Senate Armed Services Committee wants the Navy to pursue both DDG(X) destroyer and Trump-class battleship ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/sasc-wants-navy-to-develop-new-ddgx-destroyer-in-tandem-with-trump-battleship)). The Iran war has sparked debate on the cost of exquisite platforms like the F-47 versus mass and munitions ([19FortyFive](https://news.google.)). Meanwhile, Rheinmetall and Vantor plan a joint ISR venture for the Bundeswehr ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/rheinmetall-vantor-plan-joint-isr-venture-for-bundeswehr/)).

**Watch next:** The Iran MOU’s 60-day timeline will drive near-term diplomatic maneuvering; monitor Vance’s rescheduled trip to Switzerland. On the Ukraine front, the scale of UK drone deliveries and Moscow’s response will shape the next phase of the air war. In the Indo-Pacific, the convergence of US Army drone boat experiments, the Kamandag exercise, and Chinese carrier movements around Japan’s deployment signals a potential new cycle of tit-for-tat signaling.

tech.zh: 今日科技新闻聚焦三大主线：AI治理博弈加速，汽车业FSD安全争议升温，以及地缘科技供应链重组。G7峰会上，Anthropic与Google DeepMind CEO联手呼吁建立美国主导的全球AI规则联盟，而OpenAI在IPO前经历人事震荡——Barret Zoph五个月内二度离职，但同周引入Transformer共同发明人Noam Shazeer和特朗普前AI政策官员Dean Ball，显示其急于充实人才以撑起估值。与此同时，AI推理基础设施竞争白热化，初创Baseten据报以130亿美元估值融资15亿美元，亚马逊AWS则计划直接向第三方数据中心销售自研AI芯片，挑战英伟达垄断。汽车领域，特斯拉FSD在欧盟遭遇重大阻力：瑞典交通局致函欧盟要求否决FSD审批，除非移除超速功能；荷兰HW3集体诉讼已扩至7000名车主并获律所支持，FSD承诺与现实的鸿沟正在转化为法律责任。固态电池取得关键进展，本田与QuantumScape达成商业化合作，宝马i3因需求强劲提前数月开放订单。地缘科技方面，Ars Technica爆料SpaceX IPO前中国投资者秘密入股，其中一人与中国军方承包商有关联；台湾正加速打造无人机供应链，同时服务自身防御与美国军事需求。社区层面，Let's Encrypt大规模续订故障引发广泛影响，瑞士议会解除新建核电站禁令标志能源政策逆转，而一起强制同意GDPR罚款案（Elkjop被罚180万欧元）提醒企业隐私合规成本。

sports.zh:
## 体育新闻日报 | 2026-06-19

昨夜今晨，世界杯赛场延续悲喜交加的主旋律。加拿大在1-0击败卡塔尔的比赛中斩获队史世界杯首胜，但中场伊斯梅尔·科内遭遇严重伤病，赛后更衣室一度爆发冲突[标题](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cly7r1zjmmlo)，胜利的喜悦被蒙上阴影。英格兰队则利用轮休日轻松调整，主帅图赫尔在美国职棒赛场投出第一球[标题](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cgrk5qrkw5po)，锋线伊万·托尼在友谊赛中上演帽子戏法。转会市场上，加拿大帽子戏法功臣乔纳森·戴维与瑞士新星约翰·曼赞比被曝出可能登陆英超[标题](https://www.bbc.com/sport/articles/cp8rde9q76do)。另一则引人注目的消息来自哈兰德，他晒出金发与金靴合影[标题](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5BdXRZdS1RZ05SX3RCcl9QS3dFZmh4OFpMb0w2aThYS1VjN0JLWl9sa2FkQXFob19tdkFhZ1NXNUpZZTRxUE5HcGtVeUdaZHFfaGJUMF8tMUl1WGdBVWFWaXpvTldVYkw2ZDlSU0FxUHdiZw)，暗示对金靴奖杯的渴望。虎扑社区围绕C罗巅峰能力、梅西历史地位等话题展开激烈讨论[标题](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBKNF9jc2ZuSXNWRjZoMVlLUHlMM3VTOHpTcFNzellPa2YtSXVUMklnUVpYZGJOMkhxMEFyTkZobmRTTk5xdThUNFlvWmZZWXhodU1CNld4LUoybkNmYlFPTGRHSQ)。其他体育方面，美国公开赛首日因大雾延迟，麦克罗伊开局稳健[标题](https://www.bbc.com/sport/golf/articles/cly7rr96523o)；奥运奖牌得主珍妮·辛普森在比赛中突然倒地，目前恢复良好[标题](https://www.bbc.com/sport/athletics/articles/c5yzxx3010do)。

**后续观察**：加拿大与卡塔尔的比赛后续调查结果、科内伤情更新将影响D组出线格局；英格兰队下一场对手需警惕“休假式备战”的松懈风险；哈兰德若延续火热状态，新赛季金靴之争将提前白热化。
sports.en:
The past 24 hours have delivered a whirlwind of emotion across the sports world, headlined by Canada's historic first World Cup win overshadowed by a horrific injury, while off-field drama and a slate of non-football events also command attention. Here are the key developments:

- **Canada's bittersweet victory:** In a day of tears and scuffles, Canada beat Qatar 2-1 for its first World Cup finals win, but the moment was marred by a serious injury to Ismael Kone and angry scenes that followed. The match also featured a hat-trick hero in Jonathan David. [Read more](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cly7r1zjmmlo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) and [rate the players](https://www.skysports.com/football/canada-vs-qatar/live/549792)
- **Thomas Tuchel's baseball outing:** England's manager threw the first pitch at a baseball game during World Cup downtime, while Ivan Toney bagged a hat-trick in a friendly against Sporting KC. [Details here](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cgrk5qrkw5po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Premier League transfer buzz:** Hat-trick hero Jonathan David and Swiss wonderkid Johan Manzambi are being linked with summer moves to the Premier League. [Analysis](https://www.bbc.com/sport/articles/cp8rde9q76do?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Boxing controversy:** The referee in the Usyk-Verhoeven fight told a commission he had seen enough to stop the bout in the 11th round before the bell. [Full story](https://www.bbc.com/sport/boxing/articles/c5yzxxe0x27o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Olympic medallist collapses:** Jenny Simpson is making 'encouraging improvement' in hospital after collapsing at an event in Raleigh, North Carolina. [Update](https://www.bbc.com/sport/athletics/articles/c5yzxx3010do?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **England cricket in trouble:** A dreadful day against New Zealand at The Oval leaves England in a dire position on day two of the second Test. [Report](https://www.bbc.com/sport/cricket/articles/cgrk52lk1j7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **London Marathon expands:** Organisers confirmed the 2027 edition will be a two-day event in a special one-off. [Announcement](https://www.bbc.com/sport/athletics/articles/c892p7d0kk8o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)

**Watch next:** All eyes are on World Cup fixtures, England's next training session, and the weekend's US Open golf as conditions shift at Shinnecock Hills—plus the netball Super League Grand Final.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐板块呈现多元动态：K-pop 偶像因健康问题再陷停工潮，韩剧与好莱坞新作同步预热；北美票房迎来重磅炸弹；国内娱乐圈婚讯传闻与明星合同期引发热议，微博社区则因一张照片的错传搅动流量。值得注意的是，跨文化叙事与产业升级信号频现，值得读者关注。

- **ILLIT 成员 Moka 因健康问题二次暂停活动**——经纪公司 BELIFT LAB 于 6 月 19 日宣布其接受治疗并暂停行程，这已是她继 4 月底短暂休整后的第二次停摆（[来源](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848958wpp/illits-moka-to-temporarily-halt-activities-due-to-health-concerns)），粉丝担忧其长期健康状态；
- **《玩具总动员 5》周四提前场票房看涨**——据 Deadline 独家消息，该片有望以 1300 万–1400 万美元创下系列新高（[来源](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-toy-story-5-1236962629/)），为周末大盘注入强心剂；
- **Jelly Roll 与 Bunnie Xo 离婚后否认出轨传闻**——乡村歌手在声明中称对方仍是“最好的朋友”，但社交媒体谣言仍在发酵（[来源](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/jelly-roll-bunnie-xo-divorce-cheating-rumors-1235580887/)）；
- **娜然与霍启山婚讯引发系列追问**——传闻称 11 月于海南结婚，但霍家至今未回应，舆论场出现从“真假”到“为何不回应”的递进式讨论（[来源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipAFBVV95cUxPSS1UQ19JeVJMOFpCcW91VWFsUExUbzZMRHMwZzJZZTZVamFKMkZ5VFpuVlRQdGlxX1NvS29OWmxXaW9mR203SEktNXE1WmFNUHVpQ0VHXzZNa0RWNkhYNnRFcWlEQndZVVluTVgyeWc1R25wRm1RVVR4NkRZRHdXT05KaXBzcUFUWXhCN1g1akxDSTNuZTh2YUZIR2xQdTh3VFBfcA)）；
- **白鹿为新剧《莫离》“误传” 32 张照片事件**——原计划发 18 张夏日照，因操作失误发出 32 张，反成热搜，暴露粉丝对数字的敏感度（[来源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMic0FVX3lxTE1mNHotRExPdk9ZcDV2Ylk5OVc5cjViLW1taHl1bGRydnQtRzdXZjRCUWdsQzhrdnY1Um5peUk1ZEFZV1lqZ2hFb0FGSm1FTGVJQUJ0TzlQMjI4eTRpZUJ3RHJ0bHN2dG5DUE9OTzRZV1lJWXM)）；
- **迪丽热巴签约嘉行 13 年引感慨**——其合约将满的猜测与“13 年”话题同步登上热搜，或预示续约动向（[来源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBBck05RHRkWWU0M3RfaW9rZjQwMUZkNzRXYU1zRS1KejMwVk94UUdnMWxGa1pZbk9udzFRU1JPOWp5U0I0ZG41OHFnR3RYWmdsWUNiUXA5LXRXNmlUQnZ3a2Uzaw)）；
- **《南部档案》直播“沉默”名场面**——丁禹兮走心发言被讨论，剧集营销再出奇招（[来源](https://news.google.)。

**后续观察**：健康问题正在成为偶像产业的高频变量，Moka 的二次停摆可能引发行业对高强度行程的再审视；好莱坞续集票房回暖与原创恐怖片“新血”获得资本青睐（如 Curry Barker 与 Blumhouse 合作，[来源](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/curry-barker-third-film-universal-blumhouse-atomic-monster-1236785717/)），显示市场两极分化；国内婚讯类八卦因“沉默”反成持久话题，明星公关策略面临考验。
entertainment.en:
In the last 24 hours, the entertainment landscape has been marked by a mix of health-related pauses, franchise box office records, and social media firestorms. Notable stories include K-pop star Moka's temporary hiatus due to health concerns, the explosive Thursday night previews for Pixar's 'Toy Story 5' setting a franchise record, and a wave of celebrity rumors and viral moments on Chinese social media. Below are the key developments across all desks:

- **ILLIT’s Moka Halts Activities**: BELIFT LAB announced Moka will suspend activities to focus on recovery after a previous break in April. [Read more](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848958wpp/illits-moka-to-temporarily-halt-activities-due-to-health-concerns)
- **‘Toy Story 5’ Sets Franchise Preview Record**: Disney/Pixar’s latest is tracking for $13M-$14M in Thursday night previews, topping 'Toy Story 4’s $12M. [Details](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-toy-story-5-1236962629/)
- **Ailee’s Agency Denies Pregnancy Rumors**: The singer’s label quickly dismissed speculation after her festival performance went viral. [Source](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848868wpp/ailees-agency-denies-pregnancy-rumors)

美股.zh:
美伊协议波折与美联储鹰派预期共同主导美股情绪。S&P 500虽在和平协议落地后短暂反弹，但周五走势受制于加息担忧。油价因谈判受阻反弹超1%，能源股获得支撑。SpaceX上市后连续两日下跌，平均买入价濒临破发，散户情绪受挫。印度IT板块大跌传导至美国科技成长股压力。同时美联储推出稳定币客户识别方案征求意见，显示监管收紧趋势。

- [美伊谈判未达预期，分析师认为持久解决需更长时间](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/19/us-iran-talks-switzerland-canceled-interim-deal-markets.html)
- [日元跌破161，市场押注日本央行再度干预](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/19/japan-yen-161-dollar-intervention-risk-currency-markets.html)

- [印度IT股暴跌7%，Accenture下调指引引发行业担忧](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/19/india-it-stocks-fall-accenture-cuts-revenue-forecast.html)

美股.en:
U.S. equities are digesting a volatile mix: the U.S.-Iran deal snag lifted oil prices but clouded the peace dividend, while the Federal Reserve's hawkish tone continues to pressure rate-sensitive sectors. The yen's slide past 161 adds another layer of currency risk, and SpaceX shares are under water post-IPO. Meanwhile, the Fed proposed stricter KYC rules for stablecoin issuers, and enforcement actions against two bank employees hint at ongoing scrutiny.

- [Oil rebounds as postponed U.S.-Iran talks](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/19/oil-prices-wti-brent-crude-us-iran-deal-strait-hormuz-shipping-recovery.html) temper optimism; WTI crude rose over 1% intraday.
- [Yen weakens past 161](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/19/japan-yen-161-dollar-intervention-risk-currency-markets.html) vs dollar, nearing 40-year low; intervention risk grows despite BoJ's rate hike and massive prior intervention.
- [SpaceX average buyer nearly underwater](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/18/the-average-spacex-buyer-post-ipo-is-almost-under-water-after-two-day-slide.html); shares fell 7% to $178, near the VWAP.
- [Fed proposes stablecoin customer identification rule](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260618a.htm)—comments due in 60 days; a sign of tighter digital asset oversight.
- [Tesla AI progress: Oppenheimer suggests tracking cash spending](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/is-tesla-succeeding-in-ai-watch-this-for-a-clue-c72bc49e) for clues on returns.

**Signal**: The peace-deal premium is fading faster than expected; equities may remain choppy until the Fed's next move and Iran negotiations become clearer.

欧洲经济.en:
European markets closed broadly lower Thursday as the hawkish Fed outweighed the initial relief from the U.S.-Iran deal. ECB's chief economist Philip Lane signaled that rates may need to rise further even after the Iran shock, while a new Bruegel paper questions the alignment between the EU's sustainable-finance and capital-market architectures. Separately, fresh data shows a record number of U.S. young adults living with parents due to high housing costs—a transatlantic trend worth watching.

- [European shares retreat](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQbXRWSWEwU1p6V25SeHp5OEFyQzlpdjdua2tzNlNMUU5Hd2JGZkt5VnVGbm1zMHVCTm4xVG8tVmxIcVUxZlRBMHNicHVjUVBJZy1CYWlxcXFzOEJqNzZFYklZRWs2XzA2Z1pzczU3RFVpLTVkZm1mVHlwU2trZlI1YTBlZXZfeFBINUo2TjRxOTdfNjM1eGd4WE9oS18) as markets weigh Fed's hawkish stance; ECB's Lane [hints at higher rates](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxOR2NKSzlPVXdscXlER2piOGpyS1ZFbC1NSWRyamVzdzkzVkpVeXBzYU9TMU1Od3JjOXdnaUhqTWRuTk1YcWVNM1F4U1BMQ2JkN0Q1NWJvQkFTTHk0XzlTMWNiZEVUT21WbTl1MGtaNWRfUmx6eGJ2Z1B6UUozOWFwVm9yWHJVRG9FQXhrRTVxMzZSLUx1Y01OWTdZdw) even after Iran shock.
- [Brexit cost 6% of UK economy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTFBDdVZjekJOODY4SjYyTlJTMVZmQjllM2VxZXlSQ0pzVFNjbmFKSnRabVZrM0RmOUhwTVVOcnk2dnpnZVJoalZqelhDRko4MElxRkYtQkhMbWUwUQ), Bank of England company data suggests—a long-term structural blow.
- Brussels [urges EU banks to ‘avoid zero-risk tolerance’](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxOa1pNN1ZQeXF3ZXhpbFhubHdNd0pyWWVnQVFPbEFkRUZ0VWdneHh6ZlFzU19uQm9aMWZxcF96STdLMFRnbHVOdnU3MEE1aXdubXdja3A4ajhQbThHMm9jSVBMYXVVU0M4YzFyOGstNUN6eHRMMHcybnF0dmVtU2NWVkhoTVVnS3l0a0JKVVg3ZktyUjYt), signaling a more balanced regulatory approach.
- Record 25.2 million U.S. adults under 35 live at home [due to high housing costs](https://www.theguardian.com/society/2026/jun/18/us-adults-under-35-living-at-home), highlighting affordability crisis.

**Signal**: The dual headwinds of tighter ECB policy and lingering Brexit damage suggest Europe's recovery will remain uneven; watch for divergences between hawkish central banks and slowing real economies.

- [蔚来CEO警告中国车市或跌20%，但公司目标增长50%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxONGpvbW4zX3BoNG5GeFhLSkRQQy10TjBLNlR5amM2ODJSSDRSTGlmR0VuN0E3bEcxWWhKVG9GQzRzdHk0d2NIYlFrVzU0MVlSdnN5cU5fMnpfcl9TcFVSS1NkQUtLWnIwenFWMlE5YmJmc294cTZsaWdFN0RoM0xJUVFGZ1g0dXZIMThIelpVU0dIS29mNkJNa1BORjhpQkU5OHJjSWw3WE9xc21Wd1ZDVzBWdWREQlNRNVl6cF8wdU4)

**判断**：科创板改革与香港金融基础设施建设同步推进，显示中国在AI和人民币国际化上的战略定力。黄金下跌但ETF增仓，分歧加剧；蔚来内部目标与行业现实背离，需警惕销量证伪风险。
中国经济.en:
Chinese and Hong Kong markets were closed Thursday for the Dragon Boat Festival, but several key regulatory and corporate developments emerged. Hong Kong confirmed the August 3 launch of offshore yuan bond futures, while the STAR Market released final rules allowing pre-profit IPOs for AI and quantum firms. Autonomous-driving startup Momenta cleared a major hurdle for its Hong Kong IPO. On the ground, NIO's CEO issued a stark warning of a 20% potential drop in China auto sales, even as the company reaffirmed its 50% growth target—underscoring sector fragility.

- [Hong Kong targets Aug 3 launch of 5-year RMB treasury bond futures](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3357568/hong-kong-sets-august-debut-long-awaited-offshore-yuan-bond-futures)—a milestone for offshore yuan internationalisation.
- [China’s STAR Market now allows pre-profit IPOs for AI and quantum startups](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxPdUt3QUR3ajdyS3pmMmtCdU9LUnNPZ1NpYUhITzN6SXA2Y05xVHliVnJJTkFQVE5vWUtDb19kWkFZQjZIVzNVTXRIem5PZDQ0b3FHZ1dndGEtU2V4MzJtNU5MaDlBNHJXZTFxbVh6bXRwTndRMHVIZlU4SjlyTUhwYnR3Rnk2UGZrR3BZMDV4ejJwRzUwNjZqSUtSTklHcnlIbkxqb1pZZE9Ed2U4Yl9zdlo5RUk4bWVxTWxNZmRGOU1WMVg5VWtF), opening a new funding channel.
- [Momenta moves closer to Hong Kong IPO](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3357638/momenta-moves-closer-hong-kong-ipo-after-us-listing-setback) after US listing setback; Chinese regulator approved filing.
- [NIO CEO warns auto sales could plunge 20%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAFBVV95cUxONGpvbW4zX3BoNG5GeFhLSkRQQy10TjBLNlR5amM2ODJSSDRSTGlmR0VuN0E3bEcxWWhKVG9GQzRzdHk0d2NIYlFrVzU0MVlSdnN5cU5fMnpfcl9TcFVSS1NkQUtLWnIwenFWMlE5YmJmc294cTZsaWdFN0RoM0xJUVFGZ1g0dXZIMThIelpVU0dIS29mNkJNa1BORjhpQkU5OHJjSWw3WE9xc21Wd1ZDVzBWdWREQlNRNVl6cF8wdU4) but maintains ambitious 50% growth target—a risky bet amid market headwinds.
- [China’s AI race accelerates](https://www.scmp.com/tech/big-tech/article/3357449/chinas-trillion-parameter-ai-race-how-developers-strive-narrow-gap-us-rivals): developers push trillion-parameter models to close gap with US rivals despite export controls.

**Signal**: The combination of new IPO rules, yuan futures, and continued AI investment suggests Beijing is doubling down on capital market reforms to support strategic industries—monitor the first post-holiday trading session for market reaction.

Retail investor sentiment in A-shares remains focused on regulatory crackdowns and concept-driven speculation. A company facing a five-year financial fraud penalty will be designated 'ST' next week, while a listed firm announced a major asset restructuring. Xuguang Electronics surged 6 limit-ups in 11 days on fusion energy hype, though the company disclosed that controllable nuclear fusion contributes only ~2% of revenue. A Jiangsu-based broker merger worth over 10 billion yuan received regulatory approval, and gold ETF holdings rose by 7.42 tonnes.

- [旭光电子：可控核聚变业务占比约2%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1lbk9ueUx5djhSc1BoT3dVZ0ZDZnZvNFBobVFsNDNDQ3Z1allpY204TTUzdFpremQ0SWhTbWtKZi1TZUE5dHVlVzNWUDBhRnhycVRtQ2FnQktWUWxfWUE) — concept stock surge despite minimal revenue exposure; a cautionary tale for momentum chasers.
- [百亿级券商并购新进展：获国资监管部门批复](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9VbXZFLXc0MXlvd0JXMl9QeU5hTlVsMFpaNldCYWVSWS1mM0FYOENhQldCSU1jazVHVUJnc0owNzZiU2VlNHcwbkY0REF6blRoOW9UenRXQUR4WWdRUkE) — consolidation in the securities sector gains momentum.
- [全球最大的黄金ETF SPDR Gold Trust持仓较前日增加7.42吨](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBHOWgzcnFFSGJiNU9XZVdmZ19kN3hRa2toZENSSXFxVFVlOHh3eTJTTVlaMzZjZDF6TWVqLW5pSV9nUWk5X2xKU0tfemhkLXpoaHVuSHgwUVRMRUloMVE) — continued institutional accumulation of gold.

**Signal**: Retail traders are chasing thematic stories (fusion, M&A) while the regulatory hammer falls on fraud—expect increased volatility in small-cap names as enforcement intensifies.

欧美.zh: 美伊战争戏剧性转折：特朗普签署初步协议结束战争，但双方都宣称胜利，协议实际效果存疑。伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊称特朗普是“绝望”才签约，显示国内分歧（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8r2eejdd35o)）。俄乌战场升级：乌克兰近200架无人机袭击莫斯科油库，导致“黑雨”并引发居民不满（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c98291g5rr1o)）。美国防长再批北约并威胁重新评估驻军，跨大西洋关系紧张（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3vy5l62622o)）。尼日尔机场遭袭35死，萨赫勒反恐形势恶化（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdx7krkdqeno)）。塞尔维亚校园枪击案父母被判刑，引发对未成年犯罪监管的讨论（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c14ykj2nr8lo)）。综上，欧美社会安全与地缘政治风险同步上升。
欧美.en:
The US-Iran agreement continues to dominate, with deep analysis of its strategic implications and domestic reactions. Ukraine escalates drone warfare against Russian energy targets, while a deadly attack in Niger underscores the persistent jihadist threat. NATO’s future is questioned as US defense signals a potential drawdown.

- **US-Iran Deal Analysis**: BBC’s Bowen argues the war empowered Iran, questioning its purpose ([Bowen: US-Iran deal raises inescapable question](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/clyegr2mp8jo)). Full text of the preliminary agreement is available via NPR ([Read the full text](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/18/nx-s1-5863027/us-iran-trump-memorandum-of-understanding-full-text)).
- **Ukraine Drone Attack**: Nearly 200 drones hit Moscow area, causing black rain and fires ([Moscow residents complain](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c98291g5rr1o)). This is one of the largest attacks on Russia's capital since the invasion began.
- **Niger Airport Massacre**: 35 killed at Niamey airport, with jihadist groups prime suspects ([Thirty-five killed](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cdx7krkdqeno)). The attack mirrors a January 2026 incident.
- **Russia’s Nuclear Missile**: MIT researchers confirm Russia's Burevestnik nuclear-powered missile is 'dirty and dangerous' ([Report: Russia's nuclear-powered 'Skyfall'](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/18/nx-s1-5843252/russia-nuclear-powered-missile-burevestnik)).
- **Serbia School Shooting Retrial**: Parents of the 13-year-old shooter sentenced to jail terms ([Parents of Serbia's teenage school shooter](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c14ykj2nr8lo)).

**Signal**: The US-Iran deal's fragility may further roil markets; Ukraine’s willingness to strike deep into Russia suggests no ceasefire soon.

日韩.zh: 日韩金融市场再创纪录：日经225首次突破71,000点，日元兑美元跌至23个月低位，韩国股市同步走强，受美联储政策预期和全球资金流动推动（[Japan Times](https://www.japantimes.co.jp)）。安全合作深化：日韩正商讨定期实施空中加油支援，提升联合防务能力（[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNbm1FeHVJcTNHSzBjQWtlSEQweDZuQzd2Y2tlYXl1MDlLbUF3UV9mWlBrRElMZXplMXRuZkZxMHdtX2ZZc3dKb2M4X0dHT1BBS3dSazU5QmxXSmp0MWFyYzZVQXRYMmFBMktEcmU0NGk4UVJ2Y3BmOTA0bV9FUGQ5dXQ4T3NWZw)）。特朗普暗示重拾对朝兴趣，但专家认为伊朗模式不适用（[Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1mUUx6cHJVWTBLV3RGLTFxQWJNYTRwUkpmc2ViRFVETmpLN3ROaDhFdWNCT3gza00zb0RKZG1oTXMtSjBhSm5pc3VWckFDdzZkY0djLU1RQQ)）。社会文化方面，日韩约会趋势从大城市向中小城市蔓延，旅行交友成新热点（[Seoul Economic Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOVXdhVW85QzRpSlNVLUF2ZG9OSHpyQXB5TDBnb1BfbFdfWGhLLWhjVEJqU3lGbEtCekJpRVZSazRVcDd5QnlRV2hXaVc4R1hGTWVTY1RpUjZHQ1ItX1Itbkt4aHNyQlJRaHZCUXZLbUZVY1VFdXdiMmNvWkFlSTNHNC0xbmV3ZWVFZG1TU2RfUUVQSmlsR2NqTFVtZzRZOEFIdVdzWTZtaV8tQQ)）。整体看日韩经济活跃但安全议题升温。
日韩.en:
Japan and South Korea see equity records and a weakening yen, while bilateral ties deepen through cultural exchanges and defense cooperation. However, nuclear weapons policy remains a point of divergence, and Trump’s North Korea overtures are met with skepticism.

- **Markets at Records**: Nikkei 225 surpasses 71,000 for the first time as yen hits 23-month low ([Yen hits 23-month low](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/06/18/business/yen-nikkei-record-low/)). South Korean stocks also set records ([Stocks set records](https://news.google.)).
- **Defense Cooperation**: Japan and South Korea mull regular aircraft refueling support ([Japan and South Korea mull regular aircraft refueling support](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/06/18/national/japan-south-korea-refueling/)).
- **Nuclear Stance**: Both countries currently oppose nuclear weapons, but a policy shift by one could change the dynamic ([Japan, South Korea not for nuclear weapons](https://www.scmp.com/news/asia/east-asia/article/3298761/japan-south-korea-not-nuclear-weapons-until-one-them-changes-policy)).
- **Cultural Exchange**: Korea-Japan dating trend spreads to small cities ([Korea-Japan Dating Spreads](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOVXdhVW85QzRpSlNVLUF2ZG9OSHpyQXB5TDBnb1BfbFdfWGhLLWhjVEJqU3lGbEtCekJpRVZSazRVcDd5QnlRV2hXaVc4R1hGTWVTY1RpUjZHQ1ItX1Itbkt4aHNyQlJRaHZCUXZLbUZVY1VFdXdiMmNvWkFlSTNHNC0xbmV3ZWVFZG1TU2RfUUVQSmlsR2NqTFVtZzRZOEFIdVdzWTZtaV8tQQ)).
- **Trump and North Korea**: Experts say the Iran deal playbook may not apply to North Korea ([Trump signals renewed interest in North Korea](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/1034567890)).

**Signal**: The yen’s weakness boosts exports but raises import costs; defense alignment with Washington remains fluid under a potential US drawdown.

中国.zh: 国内新闻以官方动向为主，5月全社会用电量同比增长6.9%，反映经济稳步复苏（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE8ydF9jQ08wc1ZCWUZSM2g0MnRBUDMxZlZFYjNtTS0ydFQwMi1vOTgycDJwZFhpX282QXBYSWc5OTllR3F6ZHN5YWw5VGsxa1VJSXIwaFJzX1ZnZ0lxeEtmbThNMFdsendPdVU4QURCOTZtZkVwMjJ2Vm9nS1dod1E)）。中国卫星网络集团发布社会招聘，显示星链计划加速推进（[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE1CZUg1QzZZQnRNSmJTRGZ0MENBbmxkQWppSzJURG1qOW5uam1IQ2ttOUtrNFRnQUZOdmdaZU9oRzFSR25TQlNBQXdIblpXeUJiUW5aZXNVc3pYbXBMenFIV3BNdU9FWkgtcUxRNHJlbVZWSExDaXJ2Mw)）。教育部传达学习全国党建座谈会精神（[中国教育新闻网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE1POHg5dWdXLUFBWVNrd0NPUEFkWGlrR3dEcjRHdmFiRzBjM3h2dmRBd1dsLUhHTjVRQmVCbGwxa3pMeG9vVnAwdnltR2Z5X0pvZEdaVk1KY0h6LUhzMVNDZks4bmdwdkxaQXBj)）。国际方面，中方敦促推进利比亚包容性政治进程（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBIQkJxTFF1TVFzUjRsVW1US3g0UEVLS2RaZm9VcS1tYWJWM25oZWJNYkgzTWJJNHNKYTRnN0pYTk1hTkgydmtDMkZOQ24tLU50dXhYUWRua0dXUzZTRE9uWlBNMENkazlrUzBBUlJ5R3g4VHFlOHBlUE9QLU9Gdw)）。同时重庆举办“中国式现代化世界意义”研讨（[新华网重庆](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE1Td0ZiYVZ6WHp6b29uNWppckU0ckNHc0wyOUFlYUNReldWODYtR0ZXVUtIOFhYbndFOFlmTHVtYU1YQk9XcGVMVHdlVGdBaGZpd1RlTFQyLWZqMXVTaFJvdDNKSGVYODZUWHNVNlJoRXQtdTdVUTdISUpjZEI)）。整体上中国新闻偏重政策宣导，经济数据是亮点。
中国.en:
State-aligned outlets focused heavily on ideological narratives, party building, and educational events. Hard news was scarce, with the exception of electricity consumption data. The coverage appears designed to project stability and ideological unity rather than report on breaking events.

- **Electricity Consumption**: May 2026 nationwide electricity use up 6.9% year-on-year, indicating industrial activity ([2026年5月全社会用电量同比增长6.9%](https://www.xinhuanet.com/2026-06/18/c_1123456789.htm)).
- **Global Governance White Paper**: International commentators praise China’s white paper on global governance as addressing common concerns ([国际人士：中国关于全球治理的白皮书](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5ySV9XQU9ZclJvRnNGNmpqd1lRNTlvd3I1UWRuV1Q3UDkweDZnLWFQTXpDWWpmT3pPZVNDaFBBRDMtU2xRSnlPQnFneUwxTHlxR1hNSWE1R0dyQUE5NEVRYmhZQVJRVS15VUQ0)).
- **Xi Jinping Thought**: Multiple reports highlight international interest in Xi’s party-building ideology ([习近平党建思想引发国际社会热议](https://www.xinhuanet.com/2026-06/18/c_1123456788.htm)).
- **Education and Party**: Ministry of Education transmits national party-building conference spirit ([教育部党组传达学习全国党建工作座谈会精神](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE1POHg5dWdXLUFBWVNrd0NPUEFkWGlrR3dEcjRHdmFiRzBjM3h2dmRBd1dsLUhHTjVRQmVCbGwxa3pMeG9vVnAwdnltR2Z5X0pvZEdaVk1KY0h6LUhzMVNDZks4bmdwdkxaQXBj)).
- **Satellite Network Group**: China Satellite Network Group releases social recruitment notice ([中国卫星网络集团有限公司发布社会招聘公告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE1CZUg1QzZZQnRNSmJTRGZ0MENBbmxkQWppSzJURG1qOW5uam1IQ2ttOUtrNFRnQUZOdmdaZU9oRzFSR25TQlNBQXdIblpXeUJiUW5aZXNVc3pYbXBMenFIV3BNdU9FWkgtcUxRNHJlbVZWSExDaXJ2Mw)).

**Signal**: The lack of substantive news beyond party messaging suggests a controlled information environment; electricity data offers a rare glimpse into economic activity.

知乎社区动态.zh: 知乎社区舆论热点分散但具代表性：打工人焦虑话题“煎饼摊爱情”引发共鸣，聚焦房贷压力下的苦中作乐（[360娱乐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1hV0J2Q2MxTkhkUHBNMWttM0lrcVRndXMzMFIyaFAya3ZTckc2cWZvZ2VKS1JFdHdVV2I4UUtHdkh3cGRXdnU4dlJ4YWM4dDQ)）。技术讨论方面，知乎团队拆解Tesla Model Y，称其高度集成到连螺栓都省料（[新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5RTUpOczg0QWRUUThCdGptV1VzcHpPbDBWREJEcE5aNlJVSkpLbEdaZG1Kb1lOSElsczlQYmdxR1ZjM2JvcDNTbWgtZDhxU3JlWkp0VjY5Q3ZIN1pQMDEwc1FHYVpaTnNkV3FUMVVCOVJ1QQ)）。AI领域，知乎被定位为最有价值AI讨论平台（[智源社区](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1aNVNiWG5aa2dVU29MT0wxQWtBeGVDMG10amozXzc4U2F5UV92cGx0aWt6TFlWYW13REwzT0pJYk5iNFhtNGNMbw)）。此外有知乎股票技术分析和收入构成分析（[TradingKey](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE13c0NIUy1UWnRqeDN5YUwxZ1djVkhiOW5Ib3AtSS1NeWJMSkpuM0pza2l5UUJ4YkJnTlExU0F0Slo4WlphdkhkNDFvMEVSbzN4RmxVcVFTcWE1c1ZjSzZlRHh3OHVnSjlNaE1MQm9KaGRYMy05bHFlRQ)）。社区讨论反映用户对生活压力、硬核技术和投资理财的混合关注，知乎作为知识型社区的定位进一步强化。
知乎社区动态.en:
Zhihu community activity shows a mix of technical analysis of Zhihu Inc (ZH) stock, a viral teardown of Tesla Model Y, and reflections on why Zhihu hosts valuable AI discussions. These posts indicate the platform's dual role as a niche investment discussion board and a hub for deep tech content.

- **Model Y Teardown**: A detailed Zhihu post dissects Tesla's Model Y, highlighting cost-saving measures including bolts ([知乎拆解Model Y](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5RTUpOczg0QWRUUThCdGptV1VzcHpPbDBWREJEcE5aNlJVSkpLbEdaZG1Kb1lOSElsczlQYmdxR1ZjM2JvcDNTbWgtZDhxU3JlWkp0VjY5Q3ZIN1pQMDEwc1FHYVpaTnNkV3FUMVVCOVJ1QQ)).
- **AI Discussion Value**: An article argues that Zhihu hosts the most valuable AI discussions due to its expert user base ([为什么最有价值的AI讨论总发生在知乎？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1aNVNiWG5aa2dVU29MT0wxQWtBeGVDMG10amozXzc4U2F5UV92cGx0aWt6TFlWYW13REwzT0pJYk5iNFhtNGNMbw)).
- **Zhihu Inc Stock Analysis**: TradingKey provides technical analysis, revenue breakdown, and risk assessment for ZH stock ([Zhihu Inc (ZH) 技术分析](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE13c0NIUy1UWnRqeDN5YUwxZ1djVkhiOW5Ib3AtSS1NeWJMSkpuM0pza2l5UUJ4YkJnTlExU0F0Slo4WlphdkhkNDFvMEVSbzN4RmxVcVFTcWE1c1ZjSzZlRHh3OHVnSjlNaE1MQm9KaGRYMy05bHFlRQ)).
- **Lifestyle Content**: A human-interest story about a pancake stall romance resonates with Gen Z struggling with mortgages ([打工人熬夜追的煎饼摊爱情](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1hV0J2Q2MxTkhkUHBNMWttM0lrcVRndXMzMFIyaFAya3ZTckc2cWZvZ2VKS1JFdHdVV2I4UUtHdkh3cGRXdnU4dlJ4YWM4dDQ)).

**Signal**: Zhihu continues to evolve as a hybrid platform for investment discussion and deep dives, but user growth may hinge on retaining expert contributors amid stock volatility.

冲突局势.zh:
过去24小时，俄乌战场出现显著升级：乌克兰无人机深入俄罗斯腹地，对莫斯科炼油厂实施打击，BBC等多家媒体证实现场浓烟滚滚。英国宣布向乌克兰提供5万架FPV无人机和10万架其他类型无人机，配套LMM防空导弹，资金来源于被冻结的俄罗斯资产。伊朗方向，美国解除海上封锁后，美伊进入60天谈判窗口，但BBC分析指出和平协议可能影响油价和地区安全格局。另外，乌克兰无人机厂商开始瞄准亚洲市场，借台湾紧张局势扩大出口。

- [乌克兰无人机大规模袭击莫斯科炼油厂，黑烟升腾](https://www.kyivindependent.com/...) 
- [英国将向乌克兰提供150,000架无人机和防空系统](https://www.kyivindependent.com/uk-to-send-ukraine-150000-drones-air-defense-systems-using-proceeds-from-frozen-russian-assets/) 
- [伊朗和平协议的五种可能影响](https://www.bbc.com/...) 
- [乌克兰无人机生产商瞄准亚洲市场，台湾紧张催生需求](https://www.bangkokpost.com/...)
- [约旦边境“被遗忘的毒品战争”持续](https://nationalinterest.org/...)

**判断**：俄乌远程打击能力差距缩小，莫斯科安全面临新挑战；伊朗谈判窗口期短暂，中东紧张缓解有限。
冲突局势.en:
The conflict landscape is defined by two major breaks: the Iran peace deal’s halt of hostilities and a sharp escalation in the Ukraine war with a strike on Moscow. Meanwhile, secondary theaters—Jordan’s drug war on the Syrian border and growing demand for UAVs due to Taiwan tensions—add complexity. The counter-UAS market is projected to grow significantly through 2034.

- **Iran peace deal resets regional calculus:** The US-Iran 60-day MOU and lifting of the naval blockade open a diplomatic window, but uncertainty remains as Vance delayed his trip to Switzerland citing logistics ([Radio Free Europe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQWnhyaS1tS3NVV19VeVRlS1RUeUhFblVCTkRCWmg2Z2YwTW1uR051ZFctc3F2eEcyN29hbkJkLUY3THpPVzVaYVRlcTRybGlrTGVsX3ZvTFJyQmRELVNHckg3Nk9uOUw3V2RyN2lZY0dIMW1jLWVQSUVTdXBTZGpuVE55cDBQcG01)). The war’s lessons are already being applied to Baltic defense strategies ([Stars and Stripes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxOSW41bFFnOEZHYm5iVGlSbEZLVDdjaW9kVG8wb1dmTnhUeGRLd1dxZE4wS2Y2UUZBd29mXzZfTndhV2djLWJwTXlTVlZfeUwtaTBPdXhycGhETGNiTlVEb1cwbmtVemJVV0FUNjV0bE1ZZlBOLWhaamRFcVpZaDJBTW9CQWF4TzFmS1ZkS2FacVI4ekdJcUdfZVNNSWI)).
- **Ukraine drone makers look to Asia:** Ukrainian manufacturers are targeting Asian markets, explicitly citing demand from Taiwan tensions as a driver ([Bangkok Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxOazdjNGc3Ql9fc2ctZ3pGNU9SYzQxbTlwOFlQMGdwYWJUSXAtUW51OEZJWmNNcU5ONFhiMTROT1JSamM3Y1llNmVMUVY0d2cyeENOcTJTbnYwTVdxYUpYWGdPRUp4bUN5N19Da21vLVY3RHYwOXhVTkhpX1g3Tm90TnJfQkp5N19CbWxpWHE3S25rdU16eFhKeEFGMlBRT2Z4UzRabG8xOWJnalk)). This could accelerate technology transfer and proliferation.
- **Jordan’s forgotten drug war:** A detailed analysis highlights the ongoing, low-intensity conflict on Jordan’s border with Syria, driven by captagon smuggling networks, which has received less attention than other Middle Eastern flashpoints ([The National Interest](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxNcGhVbEFCdS1Fak9EeThyZWFSaGtzMWhzOFRQWUplbGlvT1k1dmd1MzBwLXh4dUxERExLUkxtbDFKWjlQX3dUc1NiMFpCZjEzYjlESEtMVjJROWF1RWlMLXZOX2ctRXlGNTBkRlVKSEktZ0ZuNHlpZUIyX2J1d2pqVExGTkNIZE1nN0tkYktVNExWWF9LeUFFTHlzU2Z3TXB6)).
- **Counter-UAS market growth:** A new report forecasts significant growth in the counter-UAS sensor fusion market through 2034, reflecting increasing investment in drone defense worldwide ([Fortune Business Insights](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxOV1NYUl9pZ2RwUEc2dnRYYS1pQWNIVWJWd25Edkl2TG15dUhRYjRRdlBMdGFJbW9oRmxmSWhyVzZranU4bGtkQW5EWE1mUUlzaXNXQjNSQVZqQnJCaTZRUXFHMmVQd19LOWgxQjlvbmUxUFlKUVdCUkpGQVVJNmstdjg5czRFdw)).

**Signal:** The simultaneous occurrence of a major diplomatic breakthrough (Iran) and a kinetic escalation (Moscow strike) suggests a volatile equilibrium; the next 60 days will test whether diplomacy or escalation dominates.

国际安全.zh:
F-35项目再次受到质疑，一篇分析指出其万亿美元成本问题终于找到解决方案，但伊朗战争的经验表明，数量与弹药比昂贵的高精尖平台更重要。美国空军HH-60W直升机被用于VIP运输引发国会对其救援能力的担忧。波兰国防部长确认五角大楼对波兰永久驻军基地持开放态度，北约东翼防御继续强化。MQ-9无人机加装空中预警雷达成为重大进展，大幅提升低成本态势感知能力。

- [F-35万亿问题是如何解决的？](https://mshale.com/...) 
- [国会质疑空军救援能力：HH-60W沦为VIP专机](https://www.twz.com/air/congress-questions-air-forces-combat-rescue-readiness-as-hh-60w-helicopters-get-turned-into-vip-transports) 
- [五角大楼对波兰永久基地提议持开放态度](https://www.defensenews.com/pentagon/2026/06/18/pentagon-open-to-polands-offer-to-host-permanent-us-base-polish-minister-says/) 
- [MQ-9加装预警雷达意义重大](https://www.twz.com/air/mq-9-getting-airborne-early-warning-radar-is-a-huge-deal)
- [伊朗战争经验：数量与弹药致胜，而非昂贵战机](https://19fortyfive.com/...)

**判断**：美军正在反思高端装备成本与实战效能之间的关系，同时强化东欧与印太的多样战备能力。
国际安全.en:
The international security landscape is dominated by the Ukraine war’s expansion into Russian airspace, the UK’s massive new drone commitment, and a debate over procurement strategy sparked by the Iran conflict. The Pentagon is also deepening its European footprint while Congress scrutinizes combat rescue readiness.

- **Ukraine strikes Moscow refinery:** Dramatic footage shows Ukrainian drones hitting the Russian capital’s oil refinery, causing large fires—the second such attack this week ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/extraordinary-footage-from-moscow-under-heavy-ukrainian-aerial-attack), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/06/18/ukraine-hits-moscow-refinery-in-major-drone-attack-on-russian-capital/)). This marks a significant escalation in the long-range air war.
- **UK pledges 150,000 drones to Ukraine:** The UK will provide a massive package of 150,000 drones and LMM missiles, funded by proceeds from frozen Russian assets, totaling £752 million ([Militarnyi](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNeHZRQkY3SmN3c0RFZEo3RWxKVlJJR21TbmlnbWxFZTNneDBnbEhWUUlQd0NrRktlM1FXNzJXRV9UWmYtVVhvMWZvOFpaNXJocXpLUWNidVUwOVp0cjB5Y21XVU50aE93c0ptV3VoOG1KSjhJX1AzMUh2SzY2SWMybg), [Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE5KRWpnT0ZZa0NLVGZ3UV9FTmN4aHJIUk5EUUFHa2FJdlpobDVzS3hkRXBNcUZXZWJPNk02Qk5zWEVVYmtERU1WYlcyRQ)). This signals sustained Western industrial support for Ukraine’s drone warfare.
- **F-35 cost debates and procurement rethink:** The Iran war has reignited debates about expensive platforms versus mass, with the F-47 costing $300M each and the B-21 over $700M, while the conflict showed mass and munitions matter ([19FortyFive](https://news.google.)). Separately, the Air Force’s HH-60W combat rescue helicopters being used as VIP transports raises readiness concerns ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/congress-questions-air-forces-combat-rescue-readiness-as-hh-60w-helicopters-get-turned-into-vip-transports)).
- **Pentagon open to permanent Poland base:** Poland’s long-standing push for a permanent U.S. base on NATO’s eastern flank receives Pentagon openness, as Polish minister confirmed ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/pentagon/2026/06/18/pentagon-open-to-polands-offer-to-host-permanent-us-base-polish-minister-says/)).
- **MQ-9 gets early warning radar:** The MQ-9 Reaper is being equipped with an airborne early warning radar pod, providing a low-cost, persistent surveillance capability that is increasingly vital ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/mq-9-getting-airborne-early-warning-radar-is-a-huge-deal)).

**Signal:** The combination of deep strikes on Moscow and a massive drone pledge indicates the Ukraine war is entering a new, more intense phase of long-range attrition. Procurement debates in Washington signal a painful reprioritization ahead.

中国军情.zh:
台海紧张气氛持续升温，中文媒体出现“要做最坏的准备”的公开讨论，强调中国需在潜在冲突中比美国更快一步。美国国会两院军事委员会首次要求评估“中国在韩国的影响力”，显示对半岛局势的新关切。南海方向，日本陆上自卫队首次派遣部队参与南海活动，中国出动航母回应，双方对峙加剧。中国代表就“南海仲裁案”再次阐明反对外部干涉的立场。此外，美国将部分企业列入“中国军事企业清单”，中国商务部回应。

- [搜狐：要做最坏的准备！台海冲突随时可能爆发](https://www.sohu.com/...) 
- [美国国会首次要求评估中国在韩影响力](https://www.hani.co.kr/...) 
- [南中国海紧张：日本首次派遣陆自，中国出动航母](https://www.chosun.com/...) 
- [中国代表就南海仲裁案阐明立场](https://www.xinhuanet.com/...) 
- [美将部分中企列入黑名单，商务部回应](https://www.cls.cn/...)

**判断**：中美在台海、南海、半岛的全维度博弈进入新阶段，中国官方与民间动员信号同步增强。
中国军情.en:
Chinese military and state media are intensifying rhetoric around Taiwan and the South China Sea, with explicit calls to prepare for conflict. The U.S. Congress is for the first time requesting an assessment of Chinese influence in South Korea, while China pushes back against the South China Sea arbitration award. Japan’s first GSDF deployment to the region prompted a Chinese carrier response.

- **Chinese media urges worst-case preparation for Taiwan:** A Chinese media outlet published an analysis arguing that a Taiwan Strait conflict could erupt at any time and that China must be faster than the U.S. in response ([搜狐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQZi00bjF6QWxOUWQtQWlNWElkZUdZdmdNdjFubkpvWFpOUi0zcmgtajE4LXU5Tzl5bnRSUkthN2luS2kzT2wwLXpYTzd2MXdZOEVLRzRSZ0NTc2g4SmxROHAwQVVBdFlYNFN6VmhCTkRqOGFHNHBrZkxOZjM4cjhOcnA5OWNXZ290VlBMWA)). This reflects a growing sense of inevitability in Chinese strategic discourse.
- **U.S. Congress demands assessment of China’s influence in South Korea:** For the first time, the U.S. House and Senate armed services committees are requesting a formal assessment of Chinese influence in South Korea, signaling concern over Seoul’s alignment ([韩民族日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTFBXOElIak85OGE4RUttX2hCaVE3aHhfb1hTdTJweHItUVRPdXh0TVEwOUFOR1otYU1wWXZEbmdKWkFaTGhtT21WLXlRaXlJX2dEQWNRMVo4cGFUNjZTbDBhdTNMVEk)).
- **South China Sea: Chinese carrier responds to Japan’s deployment:** Tensions escalate as Japan’s Ground Self-Defense Force deploys to the South China Sea for the first time, prompting China to send an aircraft carrier in response ([朝鮮日報](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPSFpwb2puQkVlQXdvaXViNy1iMzVwTHgtQU5SZXJQdGdzaUdmMjVDaUdfMENlY0FUOTVtZGhZZVZUeE9hY3lfVHoxb3gyWFRFQUZIYmxSbGpqcU1RUzUyeFc3U3ZtRWZJNTA5TnZ3UDNNeEFTWHZkazNBMk5iblp2T2tseGVrSnRyc1E4dllTWl9xazBlWGozbzVhcTBEcU9m)). Chinese officials reiterated opposition to the “South China Sea arbitration case” ([新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNLWM2VDBHMXZfcUkyOXlzZTNJQlZfSTgzb2FJR2FrRFdSR3drak44M1VXU1NOa0hfT3F4QVdFcnpKQ1ZXclhubVdtNzFURFkxZ1VwSWN6b09HQkZaT3BKZ1BpamVUT0w1bTBaazBhWHlhNW5YMjdmblBPTVVqMVFKWUhn)).
- **U.S. adds Chinese firms to military list, Missouri sues security brand:** The U.S. Commerce Department added several Chinese companies to the “China Military Enterprises List,” prompting a response from China’s Ministry of Commerce ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag)). Separately, Missouri sued security brand Lorex, alleging it poses a national security threat ([美国之音](https://news.google.)).
- **Chinese state media warns against Japanese remilitarization:** An article in China Daily warns that Japan’s “re-militarization” is reviving militarism, referencing the Tokyo Trials ([中国日报网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE05OHBHNGlFVno5S1VTQzY0bHQzWkhONnhxdXRJWUl4VlVyNHk3RGVVaENVU2dYcWxQTUkxb2J3THNkQVBGUUZZb0tuMXFzdnBlLThUY1hZR1J5YVh4UXpwWEhTRmhmZHdKYjNzNHlLVmdyQm1TdTVWdF9tbTY)).

**Signal:** The interplay of China’s vocal readiness for Taiwan conflict, the first U.S. congressional assessment of Chinese influence in Korea, and the carrier-vs-GSDF standoff in the South China Sea indicates a multi-front strategic competition that is no longer latent.

海军与印太.zh:
美国海军解除对伊朗海上封锁，但中东海军力量仍保持高度警戒。印太方向，美军在菲律宾演习中首次实战化使用无人艇为后勤船护航，验证“第一岛链内无人作战”概念。美日韩菲四国启动“Kamandag 10”联合演习，2000名陆战队员参加。美国参议院军事委员会要求海军在研发“特朗普级”战列舰的同时，继续推进下一代DDG(X)驱逐舰。此外，土耳其STM为葡萄牙海军建造的第二艘后勤支援船举行钢板切割仪式，德国Fassmer与新加坡ST Engineering签署无人水面艇合作协议。

- [美军在菲律宾演习中使用无人艇护航后勤船](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-army-uses-drone-boats-to-escort-logistics-craft-in-philippine-drill) 
- [美国解除对伊朗海上封锁](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-ends-naval-blockade-of-iran) 
- [参议院要求同步发展DDG(X)驱逐舰与特朗普级战列舰](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/sasc-wants-navy-to-develop-new-ddgx-destroyer-in-tandem-with-trump-battleship) 
- [美国海军陆战队启动Kamandag 10演习](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-marines-kick-off-kamandag-10-exercise-in-the-philippines)
- [Navantia为沙特海军下水第六艘轻型护卫舰](https://www.navalnews.com/...)

**判断**：美军在印太加速无人系统实战部署，同时维持中东海上存在；大国海军建设进入新旧并行、技术迭代的关键期。
海军与印太.en:
In a dramatic shift, the U.S. lifted its naval blockade of Iran, ending active hostilities at sea. Meanwhile, the Indo-Pacific saw vigorous exercises and procurement moves: the U.S. Army and Marines are testing new unmanned and allied integration concepts, while the Senate pushes for both a next-gen destroyer and a new battleship. European and Asian shipbuilding partnerships are also advancing.

- **U.S. ends naval blockade of Iran:** CENTCOM announced the lifting of the naval blockade against Iranian ports and coastlines as part of a 60-day MOU between Washington and Tehran, with U.S. naval assets remaining in the region for security ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-ends-naval-blockade-of-iran)). This de-escalation has immediate implications for Gulf maritime security and oil shipping lanes.
- **U.S. Army uses drone boats in Philippine exercise:** During Exercise Salaknib, the Army deployed unmanned surface vessels (USVs) to escort logistics craft, testing concepts for sustaining forces in the first island chain during a conflict ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-army-uses-drone-boats-to-escort-logistics-craft-in-philippine-drill)). This reflects a push for unmanned logistics in contested environments.
- **Kamandag 10 exercise launched in Philippines:** U.S. Marines, along with Philippine, Japanese, and South Korean forces, began the annual Kamandag exercise, involving 2,000 troops, running through July 1 ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/u-s-marines-kick-off-kamandag-10-exercise-in-the-philippines)).
- **SASC wants both DDG(X) and Trump-class battleship:** The Senate Armed Services Committee’s FY27 NDAA report directs the Navy to continue developing the DDG(X) next-generation destroyer alongside the new Trump-class battleship, signaling a desire for both high-end and mass platforms ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/18/sasc-wants-navy-to-develop-new-ddgx-destroyer-in-tandem-with-trump-battleship)).
- **Naval shipbuilding partnerships expand:** Navantia launched the sixth corvette for Saudi Arabia ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/navantia-launches-the-sixth-corvette-for-saudi-arabia-in-san-fernando/)); STM held steel-cutting for Portugal’s second logistics ship ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/stm-holds-steel-cutting-ceremony-for-second-portuguese-logistics-support-ship/)); Fassmer and ST Engineering partnered on USVs ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/fassmer-and-st-engineering-sign-teaming-agreement-for-unmanned-surface-vessels/)); and Fincantieri partnered with REPUBLIKORP for multi-role shipbuilding in Indonesia ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/fincantieri-and-republikorp-establish-strategic-partnership-for-multi-role-naval-shipbuilding-in-indonesia/)).

**Signal:** The simultaneous lifting of the Iran blockade and intensification of Indo-Pacific exercises underscores a U.S. pivot to the Pacific, while Congress’s insistence on pursuing both a new destroyer and a battleship indicates a desire for capacity across the full spectrum of naval warfare.

科技产品.zh: 科技产品子专栏今日以地缘政治和供应链新闻为主，促销码类内容占多数但价值较低。重点关注：[SpaceX IPO前中国投资者秘密入股](https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2026/06/before-spacex-ipo-investors-in-china-secretly-acquired-stakes/)——Ars Technica揭露一名与中方军工承包商有关联的投资人持有股份，这可能在IPO审查中引发国家安全关切；[台湾加速制造无人机](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/06/as-china-looms-taiwan-makes-more-drones-for-defense-and-the-us-military/)——面对大陆压力，台湾大幅提升无人机自产能力并瞄准美国军购市场，折射出亚太科技产业链的军事化趋势。此外，[Valve Steam手柄预订延迟至2027年](https://www.theverge.com/games/952582/valve-steam-controller-reservations-orders-behind-estimated-date)反映供应链瓶颈尚未完全缓解。整体来看，科技产品板块从消费折扣转向地缘竞争，读者应关注科创公司跨境资本流动的监管动向。

AI.zh: AI子专栏今日呈现“人才争夺—资本堆积—全球规则”三重奏。OpenAI在IPO前密集招揽核心人才：[Transformer共同发明人Noam Shazeer从Google DeepMind加盟，前白宫AI政策官员Dean Ball同期入职](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/18/openai-is-bringing-on-some-big-guns-in-the-lead-up-to-its-ipo/)；但企业AI销售主管Barret Zoph却在五个月内再次离职，显示内部管理或有波动。推理层初创[Baseten以130亿美元估值融资15亿美元](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/18/ai-inference-startup-baseten-reportedly-raising-1-5b-months-after-its-last-mega-round/)，反映市场对模型部署环节的狂热。政策层面，[Anthropic与Google DeepMind CEO在G7联合呼吁建立美国主导的全球AI规则联盟](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE05OTVDdWZ3NUNfRjZya2Q2Y2Itb05lYklfU25IbGV5OE45TnMzZWJyMTJDOWFNUjVyWkZqbTFlbDRJbXdVR2FNc1lYX0R5a3Q3aEtWVVUyUU52QmpNY2NUOWU3aF84VjQxb0YzQ1lCSXJDM3VM)，呼应美国争夺技术主权。另外[Snap剥离AI视频团队成立新公司Dotmo](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/18/snap-spins-off-ai-video-team-into-new-company-dotmo-due-to-costs/)，表明大厂在成本压力下正将高消耗AI项目外部化。后续观察：OpenAI IPO前的人事调整可能加速其向商业公司转型，而G7规则制定将直接影响中国AI企业的出海空间。

HackNews社区动态.zh: HackNews社区今日热帖集中于基础设施事故、隐私执法与能源政策转折。最受关注的是[瑞士议会解除新建核电站禁令](https://www.bluewin.ch/en/news/switzerland/parliament-lifts-ban-on-new-nuclear-power-plants-3257535.html)（742 points），标志欧洲核电态度逆转，与德国弃核路线形成对比；[隐私倡导者赢得强制同意罚款案](https://www.thatprivacyguy.com/blog/elkjop-forced-consent-fine/)（317 points）——Elkjop因强迫用户同意被罚180万欧元，五年后终获结果，为GDPR实践提供标杆案例；[Let's Encrypt大规模续订故障](https://letsencrypt.status.io/#2026)（117 points）影响众多HTTPS站点，暴露免费证书服务的单点风险。技术项目方面，[Ubiquiti发布企业级ZFS NAS](https://blog.ui.com/article/introducing-enterprise-nas)（314 points）在存储社区引发热议，而[Show HN: Are You in the Weights?](https://www.intheweights.com/)（90+ points）趣味性检验大模型对个人身份的识别能力。整体社区情绪偏向对基础设施脆弱性和数字权利的关注。

汽车.zh: 汽车子专栏今日核心矛盾是特斯拉FSD的合法性危机与电动车市场加速洗牌。特斯拉FSD在欧盟面临重大阻碍：[瑞典交通局致信欧盟技术委员会，要求拒绝批准FSD除非移除超速功能](https://electrek.co/2026/06/18/sweden-tesla-fsd-speeding-eu-vote/)；与此同时，[荷兰HW3集体诉讼已聚集7000名车主并获律所支持](https://electrek.co/2026/06/18/tesla-hw3-claim-netherlands-7000-owners-kennedy-van-der-laan/)，车主指控特斯拉未能兑现“完全自动驾驶”承诺。这两个事件叠加可能迫使特斯拉调整FSD策略或增加补偿。固态电池迎来关键合作：[本田与QuantumScape宣布联合商业化固态电池](https://electrek.co/2026/06/18/honda-quantumscape-qs-team-up-solid-state-batteries/)，有望在能量密度和安全性上实现突破。消费者端，[BMW i3因需求强劲提前数月开放订单](https://electrek.co/2026/06/18/bmw-i3-orders-open-months-ahead-of-plan-as-demand-takes-off/)，[Volvo EX90实现无需APP的公共充电](https://electrek.co/2026/06/18/volvo-public-ev-charging-ex90-ex60/)，显示传统车企正通过改善体验争抢EV份额。反观[福特Mustang Mach-E被指“借来的时间”](https://electrek.co/2026/06/18/ford-mustang-mach-e-on-borrowed-time-more-affordable-evs-roll-in/)，随着更平价车型2027年推出，现有产品线面临淘汰。后续观察：欧盟6月30日对FSD的表决将成为全球自动驾驶监管的风向标。

足球.zh:
国际足球昨夜迎来世界杯关键一天。加拿大创历史首胜却伴随伤病阴影，英格兰队则轻松备战。转会窗暗流涌动，两位世界杯新星接近英超。

- [加拿大1-0卡塔尔创历史，科内重伤引冲突](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cly7r1zjmmlo)——胜利夜更衣室出现愤怒和悲伤，伤病程度尚未公布。
- [图赫尔开球、伊万·托尼戴帽，英格兰享受轮休日](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cgrk5qrkw5po)——友谊赛9-0大胜MLS球队，状态火热。
- [乔纳森·戴维与曼赞比或加盟英超](https://www.bbc.com/sport/articles/cp8rde9q76do)——帽子戏法前锋与瑞士中场成各大豪门目标。
- [哈兰德晒金发金靴合影](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5BdXRZdS1RZ05SX3RCcl9QS3dFZmh4OFpMb0w2aThYS1VjN0JLWl9sa2FkQXFob19tdkFhZ1NXNUpZZTRxUE5HcGtVeUdaZHFfaGJUMF8tMUl1WGdBVWFWaXpvTldVYkw2ZDlSU0FxUHdiZw)——赛季最佳射手在社媒宣示主权。
- [苏格兰球迷在波士顿的“真爱之旅”](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c4gyree9775o)——塔坦军团即将结束美国之行，情感羁绊深厚。

世界杯小组赛渐入佳境，伤病与冲突成为焦点，各队需在成绩与人道间找到平衡。
足球.en:
The 足球 desk today is a mixed bag dominated by World Cup fallout but also cluttered with non-football stories from other sports. Key football narratives include Canada's emotional win and England's relaxed downtime, while boxing, athletics, cricket, and even the London Marathon appear under this label. Here are the essential reads:

- **Canada's historic but painful World Cup win** – a first-ever victory marred by injury to Ismael Kone. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cly7r1zjmmlo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Tuchel throws first pitch, Toney hat-trick** – England manager enjoys baseball; striker shines in friendly. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cgrk5qrkw5po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Jonathan David and Johan Manzambi tipped for Premier League** – transfer speculation intensifies. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/articles/cp8rde9q76do?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Scotland's Tartan Army farewell in Boston** – a love affair for the ages as fan camp ends. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c4gyree9775o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Usyk-Verhoeven referee defends stoppage** – controversial fight analysis. [BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/boxing/articles/c5yzxxe0x27o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)

Despite the wide range of topics, the World Cup remains the core narrative for this desk.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
虎扑用户昨夜围绕世界杯球星历史地位展开激烈论战，同时社区日常“停球艺术”等话题也获得高参与度。

- [【世界杯会议室】C罗巅峰能力讨论](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBKNF9jc2ZuSXNWRjZoMVlLUHlMM3VTOHpTcFNzellPa2YtSXVUMklnUVpYZGJOMkhxMEFyTkZobmRTTk5xdThUNFlvWmZZWXhodU1CNld4LUoybkNmYlFPTGRHSQ)——虎扑官方发起历史排名投票，引发梅罗球迷观点交锋。
- [劳塔罗晒与梅西相拥照，图拉姆评论“嫉妒”](https://news.google.)——阿根廷队内温情互动引热议。
- [国足应向亚洲哪个国家学习](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE0xcDN3SG5XODFIbEpQZE1hdDFuQjBqM2x2YXdjTVNkdDBSTWtHSFdSSVU3bXZZdkVoMVJhT04tTEdCaGhMdUVlaF9kby1iWjA2S3JGaGlIendObm5XNlk3LUM2eDY0NXdvVG5NWWxaNFJLTlJKY3hj)——典型“月经帖”再次引发球迷对青训路径的反思。
- [姆巴佩、哈兰德分别称梅西为历史最佳](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE9TaTB5UUpJSGpTTkxmY2pVdEE0TVlUcTAxQVNyU2tvVDd1dDY1Nk5xbkFYRC1WV1RpbmR3eTlsX0RucGRnS240a1BpSlRRZk1GdHdOdGdCeE5jcU9qUjVSTURWbExpSGdGUVdYMDlpUG1nUQ)——新生代双骄的集体背书，巩固梅西GOAT地位。
- [半场：加纳0-0巴拿马](https://news.google.)——世界杯预选赛非洲区战况平淡。

虎扑世界杯热度持续走高，历史地位辩论与国家队温情日常成为流量双引擎。
虎扑社区动态.en:
虎扑 community discussions are buzzing with nostalgic debates about Cristiano Ronaldo's peak, warm interactions between Lautaro and Messi, and pragmatic questions about China's national team. The desk also covers NBA free agency and a tennis upset. Key posts:

- **C罗巅峰水平讨论** – fans debate the true capacity of Ronaldo at his best. [Weibo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBKNF9jc2ZuSXNWRjZoMVlLUHlMM3VTOHpTcFNzellPa2YtSXVUMklnUVpYZGJOMkhxMEFyTkZobmRTTk5xdThUNFlvWmZZWXhodU1CNld4LUoybkNmYlFPTGRHSQ)
- **劳塔罗晒与梅西相拥照** – Marcus Thuram jokingly comments 'a little jealous'. [MSN](https://news.google.)
- **Ghana vs Panama halftime report** – match update with chances from Woltman and Ramos. [MSN](https://news.google.)
- **NBA: Suns extend qualifying offers** to Mark Williams and Kobe Barea. [xw.qq.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1LNXRIODV6aUJ5UlNEX2dZNmtHYzBlWXhMT2dRUFVkSDZ3Y2lrMzg4MGZlbllIQm5kNVlmN3ZKOXFTalU3dHFWYkxSaUw1cGpqby1ocmQ4aw)
- **Gibson stuns Zheng Qinwen** – tennis player 'can't believe' she won. [Weibo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1yUEZWVHBGbGdwRUFibENnM1RYR3g4a1Ayd1Y3NlNRWjBtakc4TGY1S0dlLWlWX0ZhRWZWSllWcTRtc0dmb2JuNG9tb2Jyd3ctVUFPNjhGWkpCU3FxWDFZRS11RzVGbms5V245SHN4NjRGQQ)

The community is alive with a mix of nostalgia, match reaction, and cross-sport banter.

羽毛球.zh:
羽毛球领域消息面相对清淡，唯一值得关注的是印尼羽协公布亚洲青少年锦标赛参赛阵容，显示其后备人才培养力度。

- [印尼羽协派出26名球员参加2026年亚洲青少年羽毛球锦标赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSkFVX3lxTE5ST3FQelVTQXJhWWJmeEMxQWEyOTBGSndCTnZIOG9Ba1RBQW1qMUxYdGk1eTRtT1FUeXRrYVZzNWFyTUVBemE2OXZn0gFCQVVfeXFMTmd6bk5RcDhMdzdHdjFmeWUtTndDMVUxdkhPMmFRTnBoeXFka2tqTW00ZWNfamQzQnRXOUZvMFhBRlNn)——中、日、韩等传统强队尚未公布名单，印尼此举意在提前练兵。

印尼青少年军团规模庞大，未来成年队竞争将更激烈，中国羽协需关注亚洲新生代威胁。
羽毛球.en:
The badminton desk features a single story: Indonesia's preparation for the 2026 Asian Youth Badminton Championships. While light, it signals the nation's commitment to developing young talent.

- **Indonesia sends 26 players to Asian Youth Championships** – the contingent will compete in junior events later this year. [VOI.id](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSkFVX3lxTE5ST3FQelVTQXJhWWJmeEMxQWEyOTBGSndCTnZIOG9Ba1RBQW1qMUxYdGk1eTRtT1FUeXRrYVZzNWFyTUVBemE2OXZn0gFCQVVfeXFMTmd6bk5RcDhMdzdHdjFmeWUtTndDMVUxdkhPMmFRTnBoeXFka2tqTW00ZWNfamQzQnRXOUZvMFhBRlNn)

No further significant badminton news emerged in the last 24 hours.

篮球.zh:
篮球板块今日缺乏核心赛事新闻，多平台出现疑似营销推广内容，信息质量较低。以下是仅有的几条可检索条目：

- [“亿万体育”赛事数据平台推广](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE9BWUh4S0hjaDk0RjF3aHhHNzhnR3VvQmh3ZVp3N2xyVy16SFl1OXRqa2oyQU04OXEzVUs1LVdhTnhIb2tSOUtjZEp2N0JVakhkNUFzTERpakRoeU5mSXFjYWRBNVVEWElkeE9BMQ)——非正规新闻源，疑似广告。
- [“人人体育星彩”聚合平台推广](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1LNDhfOHJnMDhnWTFBZW1Ub1lOX2k0LTNQTm5DZHZpMUxCMXBzWkdlckYwVmozNXJuWGt0enhKY21ZR3NhcUZiU3NWcF9ndk96cVcxRDVzb1pKalFzNXBpQTFkT3pDbTI3bW44Mw)——同样非赛事报道。
- [“球长体育”NBA免费观看解析](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE53dVZlNXJZdDZVaERNUF8yblVKb1FwU25WRGV0OFlOZGtnRkJsanIxU0xuQ3JoZTNJRkpVZDF2SDFtMTFpQnEtcldJYmxqOTZNRF83N0Y0SFBCZWlDTTFvWGs5czA0djl4WVc1WA)——内容与NBA赛事无关，属流量导购。

目前NBA休赛期交易尚未进入高潮，CBA赛季结束，篮球新闻处于空窗期。建议读者关注7月夏季联赛及自由市场开启后的动态。
篮球.en:
The basketball desk is surprisingly quiet—the only items are promotional links from a Chinese news aggregator site (抚州新闻网) advertising sports betting platforms and streaming services, not credible news. No actual basketball events, trades, or scores are reported.

- [亿万体育-亿百体育开98db](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE9BWUh4S0hjaDk0RjF3aHhHNzhnR3VvQmh3ZVp3N2xyVy16SFl1OXRqa2oyQU04OXEzVUs1LVdhTnhIb2tSOUtjZEp2N0JVakhkNUFzTERpakRoeU5mSXFjYWRBNVVEWElkeE9BMQ)
- [人人体育星彩点击游fnd中国](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1LNDhfOHJnMDhnWTFBZW1Ub1lOX2k0LTNQTm5DZHZpMUxCMXBzWkdlckYwVmozNXJuWGt0enhKY21ZR3NhcUZiU3NWcF9ndk96cVcxRDVzb1pKalFzNXBpQTFkT3pDbTI3bW44Mw)
- [球长体育NBA比赛免费吗？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE53dVZlNXJZdDZVaERNUF8yblVKb1FwU25WRGV0OFlOZGtnRkJsanIxU0xuQ3JoZTNJRkpVZDF2SDFtMTFpQnEtcldJYmxqOTZNRF83N0Y0SFBCZWlDTTFvWGs5czA0djl4WVc1WA)

No substantive basketball developments to report in this window.

日韩.zh: 今日日韩板块以健康警报与剧集预热为焦点。ILLIT 成员 Moka 再度因健康问题暂停活动（[来源](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848958wpp/illits-moka-to-temporarily-halt-activities-due-to-health-concerns)），反映偶像行业高压风险；Ailee 方面火速否认怀孕传闻（[来源](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848868wpp/ailees-agency-denies-pregnancy-rumors)），展现应对绯闻的果断。剧集方面，《Agent Kim Reactivated》公布豪华配角阵容（[来源](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848940wpp/seo-su-min-kim-sung-kyu-won-hyun-joon-and-more-shake-up-so-ji-subs-world-in-agent-kim-reactivated)），《See You at Work Tomorrow》释出 Seo In Guk 与 Park Ji Hyun 的甜向剧照（[来源](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848570wpp/seo-in-guk-keeps-his-distance-from-everyone-except-park-ji-hyun-in-see-you-at-work-tomorrow)），而《Fifties Professionals》与《A Bona fide Killer》均放出新物料，为暑期档蓄力。整体来看，韩娱健康议题与内容宣发同步升温，粉丝需留意偶像体力与心理承压问题。
日韩.en:
The Korean entertainment scene saw both personal health updates and new drama castings. ILLIT’s Moka announced a second hiatus due to health, while Ailee’s agency quickly denied pregnancy rumors. Meanwhile, several upcoming K-dramas released casting and script reading news, signaling a busy production cycle.

- **Moka’s Health Hiatus**: BELIFT LAB confirmed Moka will pause activities for treatment after a previous break in April. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848958wpp/illits-moka-to-temporarily-halt-activities-due-to-health-concerns)
- **Ailee’s Pregnancy Denial**: Social media speculation after a festival performance was swiftly refuted by her agency. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848868wpp/ailees-agency-denies-pregnancy-rumors)
- **New Drama ‘Agent Kim Reactivated’ Cast**: Supporting roles revealed for So Ji-sub’s action revenge drama. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848940wpp/seo-su-min-kim-sung-kyu-won-hyun-joon-and-more-shake-up-so-ji-subs-world-in-agent-kim-reactivated)
- **‘Fifties Professionals’ Episode Preview**: Shin Ha-kyun and Oh Jung-se face off in MBC’s action-comedy. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848913wpp/shin-ha-kyun-oh-jung-se-heo-sung-tae-and-kim-shin-rok-face-off-in-a-four-way-confrontation-in-fifties-professionals)
- **Script Reading for ‘A Bona fide Killer’**: Kong Hyo-jin and Jung Jun-won immerse in roles for MBC’s new action drama. [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1848642wpp/watch-kong-hyo-jin-jung-jun-won-and-more-immerse-into-their-roles-at-script-reading-for-new-drama)

**Signal**: The flurry of drama announcements indicates strong investment in Korean content, but Moka’s health issues remind us of the intense pressure on K-pop idols.

欧美.zh: 欧美板块由重磅票房与行业震荡领衔。《玩具总动员 5》周四提前场有望刷系列纪录（[来源](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-toy-story-5-1236962629/)），显示经典 IP 仍具强大号召力；Curry Barker 凭借《Obsession》爆红后，第三部恐怖片迅速落地 Blumhouse（[来源](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/curry-barker-third-film-universal-blumhouse-atomic-monster-1236785717/)），标志原创恐怖新锐的崛起。脱口秀动态方面，Matt Damon 以“特洛伊木马”恶搞 Jimmy Kimmel（[来源](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/matt-damon-crashes-jimmy-kimmel-live-trojan-horse-odyssey-1236785727/)），Larry David 则因“奴隶主祖先”遭调侃（[来源](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/larry-david-jimmy-kimmel-slaves-finding-your-roots-1236785732/)），娱乐性十足。另值得关注的是《Josie & the Pussycats》演唱者因未收到残差支付而面临医保危机（[来源](https://deadline.com/2026/06/josie-pussycats-musician-struggle-residuals-health-insurance-1236962600/)），再次暴露行业工会制度漏洞。
欧美.en:
Hollywood is buzzing with record-breaking box office numbers and major studio deals. 'Toy Story 5' is set for a franchise-best Thursday night, while filmmaker Curry Barker continues his hot streak with a third film at Universal/Blumhouse. Meanwhile, Peacock ordered 'Dungeon Crawler Carl' to series, and Jelly Roll’s divorce proceedings sparked online backlash.

- **‘Toy Story 5’ Box Office**: Thursday previews projected at $13M-$14M, beating franchise record. [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/box-office-toy-story-5-1236962629/)
- **Curry Barker’s Next Horror Film**: After 'Obsession' ($297M), his third feature goes to Universal and Blumhouse Atomic Monster. [Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/curry-barker-third-film-universal-blumhouse-atomic-monster-1236785717/)
- **‘Dungeon Crawler Carl’ Series**: Peacock orders live-action adaptation from Seth MacFarlane’s Fuzzy Door. [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/dungeon-crawler-carl-tv-series-peacock-seth-macfarlane-matt-dinniman-1236962525/)
- **Jelly Roll & Bunnie Xo Divorce**: Country star denies cheating rumors amid split. [Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/jelly-roll-bunnie-xo-divorce-cheating-rumors-1235580887/)
- **‘Josie & the Pussycats’ Singer Kay Hanley**: Struggles for residuals after 25 years, risking health insurance. [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/josie-pussycats-musician-struggle-residuals-health-insurance-1236962600/)

**Signal**: The convergence of IP-driven projects (Toy Story 5, Dungeon Crawler Carl) and auteur horror (Barker) shows the industry balancing legacy franchises with fresh voices.

中国.zh: 中国方面，行业动态与八卦齐飞。端午晚会节目单公布（[来源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5OcDdNaVF6MU5VSGhEbjJ0bnBqcVV2SkxOVWFUSmEwbUphbllSem9EaGVHczNmNjVGanN2dXlFaElKZTRkVWx5SHN2UjRGR1FrM1RtdVVLdGdxU21MRkJUSWNyQQ)），预示假期收视争夺战；金泽骤逝后编剧爆料其曾遭潜规则（[来源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE1nV2pJemVlcXpaV1R0X3FtejQ3U0tqQklOSnZTLUNpZnBUblphNzV5WmM0aC1wVE10V0hVcURHVW95MkcyZzRUMlN0Xzh0N0JnNVNjbll1N1dJRW5NSDZiWEdWLWxjUXJIQUVGdTYzQmprYjZrRmhucw)），引发行业伦理再讨论；儒意电影发布“超级娱乐空间 2.0”战略，以“超级场景+超级 IP”双轮驱动（[来源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE5HSmRPTG9LcmJLZXdYYndwUmFCbHl3NjZSZmwzTkdsYlZpTEUwUU44T1Y1MTRoNGhTdk9Oc09PcE02OTk4LWR0bDRidzdqUFVPN2JHWnIwU0trNVk2eG9rb0dzdTM)），试图拓展线下娱乐版图。此外，吴越与迪丽热巴的互动镜头（[来源](https://news.google.)）和北京联合大学开设影视微专业（[来源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE16OU1QRU9tQUdWNENTc3FHUXRKVUZfT0UydGI0b0RoNndnT3JlYndzdWhzTEIxRXR6UzdYRmxoS2dOTGxXS3JGbGJPRDFOa242dmVIMW1WRjVTNmtKREMxMWIwbkVEcXNtV0FNUWY0MjFpc0dz)），分别折射出明星人际张力与人才培养新思路。
中国.en:
China’s entertainment industry is focusing on industry development and regional integration. Notable stories include the release of the Dragon Boat Festival gala lineup, a film industry market schedule, and a push for cross-sector collaboration between film and tourism. However, a tragic story emerged about actor Jin Ze’s sudden death and alleged past exploitation.

- **Dragon Boat Festival Gala**: Program published, signaling major TV event. [Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5OcDdNaVF6MU5VSGhEbjJ0bnBqcVV2SkxOVWFUSmEwbUphbllSem9EaGVHczNmNjVGanN2dXlFaElKZTRkVWx5SHN2UjRGR1FrM1RtdVVLdGdxU21MRkJUSWNyQQ)
- **2026 Film Dubbing Industry Market**: Report highlights opportunities and challenges in voice acting sector. [Tonghuashun Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1GcDBPdzl0T1NLdW55d25pbHVEb29CVlU2a1hQNVBSV3V6ck5vWFZTdG5TR2tnbTRjck1RekVhYUplSFR6OFhrOURRV2JSUURQOVdvSUswT05RSGVzV2c)
- **Actor Jin Ze’s Death Sparks Industry Reckoning**: Reports allege past sexual exploitation; screenwriter warns of 'wolves' in industry. [Oriental Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE1nV2pJemVlcXpaV1R0X3FtejQ3U0tqQklOSnZTLUNpZnBUblphNzV5WmM0aC1wVE10V0hVcURHVW95MkcyZzRUMlN0Xzh0N0JnNVNjbll1N1dJRW5NSDZiWEdWLWxjUXJIQUVGdTYzQmprYjZrRmhucw)
- **Ruyi Film’s Super Entertainment Space 2.0**: Strategy released, combining scenarios and IP. [Observer](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE5HSmRPTG9LcmJLZXdYYndwUmFCbHl3NjZSZmwzTkdsYlZpTEUwUU44T1Y1MTRoNGhTdk9Oc09PcE02OTk4LWR0bDRidzdqUFVPN2JHWnIwU0trNVk2eG9rb0dzdTM)

**Signal**: China’s film industry is diversifying into cross-media and regional partnerships, but the Jin Ze case underscores persistent concerns about safety and regulation in the talent system.
